gsar du rnyed son byung ba'i bod kyi mig mangs rig gnas kyi dpang rtags shig ste rdor brkos kyi mig mangs rtse gzhir dpyad pa'i snyan zhu/dgra lha zla ba bzang po/de yang bod rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa yos spyi lo1999lo'i dbyar dus kyi nyin zhig kho bo grogs po hor khang byams pa bstan dar lags kyi khyim du bcar ba'i tshe/ khong nas nye lam sngar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po sku bltams sa'i pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi mkhar shul nas mi ser rnams la rdor brkos ri mo khyad mtshar zhig rnyed son byung tshul skor gleng bar ma zad/ rdo de yang snying ci zhig yin min lta zhib byed par bod rang skyong ljongs rten 74

rdzas bshams mdzod khang gi mkhas pa bsod nams dbang 'dus lags dang lhan du bskyod rtsis yod lugs gsungs pa dang 'brel kho bor yang stabs bstun mnyam du 'gro dgos kyi skul ma gnang bar brten/ mi 'gyang bar khong rnam pa gnyis dang mnyam du lha sa nas spyi le bdun cu tsam gyi shar ngos su gnas pa'i mal gro gung dkar rdzong khongs rgya ma shang gi nub ri'i 'dabs su chags pa'i pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi gna' shul la blta bar bskyod/der bslebs dus sngon gyi tshe mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran dang skye bo dadul dka' ba rnams dbang du bsdus shing lugs gnyis kyi bka' srol bzang bo'i lam du nan gyis srong zhing / chab srid mnga' thang sra zhing brtan par byed pa'i phyogs su ma lhung ba'i bka' khrims btsan po'i gnas las mnga' 'og pa rnams 'da' ba'i skabs med pa/ spyir btang skye bos lta zhog chos srid gang gi cha la mdzangs par grags pa rnams kyis kyang zab cing rgya che ba'i dgongs pa'i gting mtha' dpog par mi nus pas sgam pa ste/mtha' yi stobs ldan rgyal khams rnams kyang 'jigs zil gyis 75

nga tshos grong mi bkra shis sogs la rdo 'di sngon gyi mig mangs rtse gzhi zhig yin 'dug na/ rgyal khab kyi rtsa che'i rig dngos khongs su gtogs nges pas/ bdag po mi byed par gang byung khang ba'i phyi logs su bzhag na shin tu nas mi 'os tshul nan gyis brjod de/der yod mi tshang mas mnyam rub kyis bkra shis kyi khang ba'i sgo ra'i nang gi zur zhig tu bslangs nas bzhagade rjes hor khang byams pa bstan dar lags nas da lta pho brang gi gna' shul gang tsam 'dug pa de dag gi rdo rnams mu mthud nas grong mi tshos do snang ma byas par khang ba gsar rgyag byed rgyur spyad na yun ring ma 'gor bar gna' shul de dag meg med du 'gro bar 'dug dgongs te/ phran la'ang zhar dang zhor du gros dris pa dang sbrags sems kyis mi bzod par ljongs tang u yi dbu khrid dang / sa gnas de ga'i shang gi mgo khrid/ de bzhin 'brel yod las khungs khag la gzigs zhib brtag dpyad kyis gang mgyogs srung skyob kyi bya thabs shig spel rogs gnang zhes re 'dun yang yang zhus par brten/ gang mgyogs su bod ljongs rten 78

rdzas bshams mdzod khang gi sgo nang 'ardzobee thub tsam byung yang / de gar nor bus nor nyams mi chod pa ltar gnas skabs rgyal sgo'i nang logs kyi khang chung zhig gi zur du lus 'dug de ltar lus pa'ang nga dang byams pa bstan dar lags gnyis nas shes rjes/don de la mngags pa'i mngag pa bod ljongs rten rdzas bshams mdzod khang gi dbu khrid dag btsal te gang mgyogs brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gis do dam nyar tshags legs po zhig gnang rogs zhes skul ma yang yang zhus par brten/ bod ljongs rten rdzas bshams mdzod khang nas kyang de ltar do snang chen po gnang lugs kyis hor khang byams pa bstan dar lags la mjal dar dang bcas sku zhabs hor khang byams pa bstan dar lags nas rang cag mi rigs rig gnas myur skyob kyi ched du srong btsan 'khrungs yul gyi pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi gna' shul nas rtsa che'i mig mangs re'u mig rdo gzhong zhig ljongs rten rdzas bshams mdzod khang la ngo sprod lag son byung bar gzengs bstod lag 'khyer 'di phul ba yin zhes pa'i gzengs bstod lag 'khyer zhig 79

dang / rgya ma shang dang grong mi bkra shis gnyis la mjal dar dang bcas bya dga' sgor lnga brgya(rgya ma shang la sum brgya dang bkra shis la nyis brgya)bcas gnang 'dug 'on kyang de skor zhib 'jug gis rig dngos kyi rin thang gsal 'byed legs po zhig gnang rogs zhes ljongs rten rdzas bshams mdzod khang la skul ma yang yang zhus kyang zhib 'jug byas 'bras skor da lta'ang mthong chos su ma gyur na/ khyim bya ma bsdad pa'i skabs su bong bus nam tshod bgyid pa'i dpe ltar rang blos gang dpog gi tshul du dpyad par bya'o//de yang bod du mig mangs nam byung zhe na/ thog mar ji ltar srid pa'i lo rgyus brjod par dka' yang / da nas brtsis pa'i lo ngo stong phrag gi yar sngon nas yod ces kha tshon gcod chog ste/ cing rgyal rabs phyi ma'i gong ma ko tsu'u yi then hphu'u khri lo drug pa spyi lo 941lo la rtsom mgo tshugs shing / gong ma khru'u te'u te'i khe yun khri lo gnyis pa ste spyi lo945lor yongs su grub pa'i rgya'i yig tshang 〈 thang yig rnying ma〉las bod chen po'i srid lugs skor brjod 80

skabs rtsed mor sho dang mig mangs rtse zhes gsal ba ltar/ da lam srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs yul gyi pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi gna' shul gyi sa 'og nas rnyed son byung ba'i rdor brkos kyi mig mangs rtse gzhi des kyang de sngon ngag rgyun tsam du lus pa'i lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul de rigs la dpang rtags byed thub/ de bzhin lo rgyus snga tshad kyi cha nas kyang / lo rgyus thog mig mangs rgyal po byung myong yod ces grags pa'i gzhis rtse khongs bzhad mthong smon rdzong gi dmangs khrod du bon gyi cho ga'i yo byad dam 'chi ltas brtag pa'i bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po zhig yin zhes grags la/kong po bon ri dang 'brel ba'i dmangs khrod shod rgyun zhig tu sngon nang ba sangs rgyas pa'i btsun pa zhig gnas ri der 'byor bas/gnas der 'tsho sdod byed pa'i bon po rnams khros nas de dang blo rig 'gran par 'dod/ 'on kyang phan tshun skad brda mi 'phrod stabs mig mangs 'gran pas bon rnams rgyal zhes byung bas/dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun de dag las kyang mig mangs ni bon chos kyi rig gnas dang 'brel ba zhig dang / de'i lo rgyus ni sangs rgyas 81

bstan pa bod la dar ba las kyang ches snga bar yod tshul gsal bshad byas yod na/ kha cig gis bod kyi mig mangs kyi rgyun ni rgya dkar nag gam sog po gang rung zhig nas dar ba'i 'dod tshul 'dzin pa de rigs ni don dngos dang mi mthun pa dngos shugs gang rung nas shes thub/ma gzhi bon gyi yig cha'i nang du mig mangs zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di 'dra 'khod pa mthong dka' na'ang / bod rgyal srong btsan yan du rgyal srid skyong ba la thabs med du mi rung ba ni sgrung lde'u bon gsum yin pa ltar mig mangs de yang rde'u 'phrul lam lde'u 'phrul gyi khongs su gtogs pa zhig yin par nges te/ mkhas dbang nam mkha' nor bus mdzad pa'i〈zhang bod lo rgyus ti se'i 'od〉ces pa'i nang de'i skor gsal bar bstan yod/ de yang de nyid las rde'u 'phrul gyi mo ni mo'i rnam pa mi 'dra ba ji snyed cig bzhugs pa de rnams kyi nang du ches rnying ma'i rang bzhin dang ldan pa 'i mo gcig yin par bstan pa'i skabs su/ rde'u 'phrul gyi mo'i lo rgyus su sngon dus su phywa legs rgyal rdzu 'phrul can gyis ston pa smra 82

ba'i seng ge la zhus pa'i ngor bstan pa'i rno mthong mo'i bye brag cig yin par bshad yod la/ mo 'di'i dpyad du'ang skyes bu'i 'byung khams kyi gnas lugs dang de dang yul gyi 'byung ba'i khams phan tshun gyi 'brel ba bcas par zhib 'jug gi sgo nas legs nyes gtan la dbab dgos pa ste/ de ni ya thog gi bon rnal ma'i bsam spyod thun mong ma yin pa zhig yin stabs/ rno mthong gi lugs 'dir rnying ma'i rang gshis khyad par can zhig yod pa'ang shes thub pa yin zhes dang / phyis kyi bon 'ga' zhig gis chos lugs su 'phags pa 'jam dpal smra ba'i seng ge shes rab kyi lhar 'dzin srol yod pa de las dpe blangs te/ ston pa smra ba'i seng ge zhes pa gshen rab mi bo che las tha dad pa zhig la ngos 'dzin srol yod na'ang / don du phywa legs rgyal rdzu 'phrul can la rno mthong gi bon ston mkhan smra ba'i seng ge zhes pa de ni gshen rab mi bo che'i mtshan gyi rnam grangs tsam zhig las ma 'das shing / de nyid gshen rab mi bo che'i sprul pa'i bkod pa zhig yin par byas na ni 'gal ba ci yang med/ rno mthong khyad par can gyi ri mo 'di'i mtshan la 83

lde'u 'phrul te/lkog gyur gyi mngon shes gsal ba'i 'phrul mo'i don yin na'ang dus phyis yongs grags su rde'u drug ces su btags pa ste/ phal cher rdo rde'u drug la brten nas legs nyes brtag pa'i mo zhig yin pa lta bur chags yod/ spyir btang du mo 'di rdo rde'u'am shel gyi rde'u gang rung bzhi bcu zhe gnyis kyi grangs la brten nas brgyag dgos pa zhig yin stabs/ rde'u yi tha snyad 'jug rung tsam zhig yin na'ang rdo del drug la brten nas mo rgyag pa'am rdo rde'u drug dgos pa'i nges pa ni cis kyang med la/ dngos don du lde'u 'phrul zhes pa'i tshig 'di brjod mi bde ba'i rkyen dang / skye bo phal gyis lde'u 'phrul gyi go don ma shes pa'i rkyen gnyis la brten nas/dus rim gyi nang skad zur chag ste rde'u drug ces pa'i tha snyad 'di byung bar mngon zhes byung bar ma zad/ mo 'di rgyag skabs de'u rnams re'u mig dgu yod pa'i nang ji ltar 'jog tshul yang zhib par bkod yod/ 84

gnam ri srong btsan gyi skabs su'ang ha cang dar so yod de/gnam ri srong btsan gyi blon po'i gras nas gtsang gi rgyal po mar mun gyi mgo bcad de de khul gyi 'bangs mi khyim dud khri phrag gnyis spur rgyal btsan po'i mnga' 'bangs su 'bul mkhan khyung po spung sad zu tse yang mig mangs la ha cang mkhas pa'i tshad du 'dzin pa ste/ 〈tun hong yig rnying〉las kyang spung sad zu(tse)mdzangs kyang kyi tshad ni/ rtsis gra gsum/ zhal lce gra bzh-i yang rna bas nyan zhing gachod/ myig mangs gra chig kyang zla la rtse na rgyal zhes gsal ba de las kyang nges shes rnyed thub cing / khyung po spung sad zu tse lta bu'i dmag don la mkhas pa'i skyes bu de rigs ni mig mangs rtse bar dga' zhing mkhas pa de'i thog nas kyang sngon dus mig mangs 'di bzhin spro snang 'phel ba'i rol rtsed kyi bye brag kho na tsam du ma zad/ dmag jus kyi rigs par mkho ba'i yo byad khyad par can zhig kyang yin pa gor ma chag des na bod kyi mig mangs skor la zhib 'jug byed pa'i las don ni spyir btang gi bya las shig ma yin na/ slad char mtsho sngon 86

dang kan su'u/ si khron sogs bod rigs 'dus sdod kyi sa khul dang / bal yul dang / 'brug yul/ 'bras ljongs/ rgya gar byang phyogs khul bcas su dar khyab yod pa'i mig mangs dang 'brel ba'i bod kyi shes rig la zhib 'jug rnal ma zhig byed thub na/ des kyang bod kyi lo rgyus kyi gsang ba 'ga' zhig brtol thub nges par ma zad/ gna' dus nas kyang bod mi rigs 'di blo rig ji ltar bkra po yod tshul ra sprod byed thub bo//'on kyang rang re'i khrod na mig mangs brtses te rgyan po 'gyed par dga' ba'i skye bo 'ga' zhig yod pa tsam las/ de'i skor la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug gis yig lam du 'god mkhan ha lam nyin mo'i skar ma tsam du zad pas/ da snga rgya rigs blo mthun dang phyi rgyal pa re gnyis kyis bris pa'i dpyad rtsom thar thor las mthong rgyu cang ma mchis/ des na 'dir yang a ri'i rgyal khongs kyi mi yin pa'i sku zhabs phi thā she'u thar gyis brtsams shing bsod nams chos rgyal lags kyis rtsom sgyur byas pa'i〈bod kyi mig mangs la dpyad pa〉zhes pa'i nang du da phan bod kyi mig mangs skor la zhib 87

'jug bgyis pa'i lta tshul 'ga' zhig bkod 'dug pa de las gal che ba re gnyis drangs te ngo sprod byas na/1 bod kyi mig mangs skor gyi dpyad rtsom thog ma de ni sku zhabs khreng zha'o li'u yis brtsams pa dang / khong ni rim pa dgu pa'i mig mangs pa zhig yin la/ da lta〈 krung go'i mig mangs dus deb〉kyi rtsom sgrig pa yang yin/ khong gi 'dod tshul la bod kyi mig mangs ni rgya rigs ga ge mo zhig gis dus rabs bdun pa'i nang khyer yong ba zhig yin par brjod/2 khreng zha'o li'u yi 'dod tshul de dang mi mthun pa'i skor la nyi hong gi he ce mu dang / a ri'i phe ri pa ran dang / phi thā she'u thar bcas kyis dpyad rtsom spel ba rnams〈 nyi hong gi mig mangs dus deb〉dang / 〈a ri'i mig mangs zhib 'jug〉ces pa sogs kyi thog bkod yod/ 3 〈 bod ljongs rtsom rig〉dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pa yan kra'an krung nas〈 dkar nag gi 'jig rten〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig cig spel te〈 gangs ljongs rig gnas〉zhes pa'i dus deb thog 88

bkod yod/ de'i nang mig mangs ni gna' dus nas bod dang rgya nag tu dar khyab yod pa tsam du ma zad/ bod du dar ba'i mig mangs kyi lo rgyus ni rgya nag las snga ba yod lugs skor dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas bstan yod/gong gsal rgya rigs dang phyi rgyal pa'i zhib 'jug pa de tshos bris pa'i dpyad rtsom rnams gtso bo rgya bod kyi lo rgyus yi ge tsam mam dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun tsam la brten pa'am/ mig mangs rtse lugs kyi goms srol tsam la brten nas rigs pas dpyad pa zhig yin pa las/ khong rnams la dus rabs bdun pa'i gong gi mig mangs skor gyi gna' rdzas 'di lta bu gang yang rnyed son byung med stabs/ dpang rtags 'pher ba'i lta tshul ni su la yang brjod du med/ 'on kyang da lam chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs sa'i pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi gna' shul gyi sa 'og nas rnyed son byung ba'i rdor brkos kyi mig mangs kyi rtse gzhi der dpyad na/ bod du chos rgyal srong btsan gong nas kyang mig mangs mig17྾17byas pa de rigs yod par nges shes rnyed thub ste/ pho brang 89

byams pa mi 'gyur gling dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus la zhib tu brtags pas kyang shes nus/de yang pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i yab gnam ri srong btsan gyis zing po rje khri pangs sum dbang du bsdus te sngar zing po rje'i mnga' khongs su gtogs pa'i mal gro rgya ma'i nang du phyag btab pa zhig yin zhing /btsan po 'di bas yab stag ri gnyan gzigs kyis sgrub par 'bad kyang ma grub pa'i bod gcig gyur gyi bzhed don bsgrub par bya ba'i slad du/spu rgyal gyi shar nub byang bcas na gnas pa'i rus rgyud tsho ba'i stobs shugs rnams dbang du bsdus nas dang thog dbus gtsang phal cher chab 'og tu chud par mdzad/ rgya nag nas sman dang rtsis bzhes/byang nas tshwa bton/sku mkhar khri brtsegs 'bum gdugs bya ba ba dmar mo'i 'o mas sbrus pa'i 'jim pas brtsigs/ chab srid mnga' thang yang stobs 'byor rgya skyed kyi rmang gzhir song ba de ltar bskyangs pa sogs te/ zhib par〈tun hong yig rnying〉las kyang /btsan po slon brtsan dang / slon kol sku mched gnyis la/ myang 90

tsengs sku dang /dbas dbyi tshab/dbas myes snang /dbas pu tshab/mnon 'dron po/ tshes pong nag seng drug gis mna' skyel dam bca' phul ba'i tshig ni/ da phan chad/ zing po rje rgyab tu mi 'dor ri/ spu rgyal spang du mi len ri/ btsan po spu rgyal la blo log byed ri/zhabs 'dren zhu ri/ gsang rgya thub pa mi byed ri/ phyi ma nang mi byed ri/ the tshom byed ri/ brtul phod par mi byed ri/ srog blos gtong mi byed ri/ btsan po slon brtsan gyis bka' ci gnang ba bzhin mi nyan ri/ gzhan sus bslus kyang nyan ri zhes mna' tshig phul lo/ /myang tseng cung dang / myang mu gseng / tshes pong na gu/ dbas myes snang / dbas pu tshab rnams kyang mna' tshig 'bul ba'i khongs su gtogs so/ /de nas dmag 'dren pa'i dus tshod gtan 'khel gnang ba ltar la kho tsho 'byor ro/ /gcung slon kol dang yum stong tsun rnam gnyis yul du bzhugs shing / btsan po khri slon btsan sku ngo mas dmag mi khri phrag tsam khrid nas dpung drangs so/ /myang tseng sku dang / mnon 'dron po gnyis stag pa sha ru la tshun chad du so lta myul zhib byed par sngon la btang ngo / /dbas dbyi tshab dang tshes 91

pong nag seng gnyis kyis btsan po spyan drangs nas/ chu chen po'i rab brgal nas lam btod/ nags tshal dang na thang gshags te g.yul bshams nas/ mkhar yu sna ni gtor/ dgu gri zing po rje ni brlag go /mang po rje bu gsum ni dru gu'i yul du bros so/ /phag gi yung ba sna man chad/kong po bre sna yan chad btsan po'i phyag tu len no/ /btsan po khri slon btsan gyis bka' phab ste/ sngar yul ngas po zer bar/ 'phan yul zhes su ming brjes so/ /myang dbas sogs kyis bstod pa'i glu phul zhing / yul ngas po'i 'bangs dbyi tshab la sogs pas/ btsan po la mtshan gsol ba/ chab srid gnam bas mtho/ dbu rmog ri bas btsan te/ gnam ri slon btsan du btags so/ /myang dbas mnon gsum gyis zing po rje'i chab srid btsan po spu rgyal gyi phyag tu phul lo/ /de nas gnam ri slon btsan sku ngo mas phyag gis bcad de/ myang tseng sku'i bya dgar/ gnyan 'dzi zung gi mkhar sngur ba dang / bran g.yog khyim tshang chig stong lnga brgya bstsal to/ /dbas dbyi tshab kyi bya dgar/ za gad gshen gyi yul sa dang /mal gro phyogs nas bran g.yog khyim dud chig stong lnga brgya bstsal to/ /92

mnon 'dron po'i bya dgar/ kho na'i pu nu po mnon la sogs pa bran g.yog khyim dud lnga brgya gnang ngo / /tshes pong nag seng gi bya dgar/ 'on gyi slon mkhar nas bran g.yog khyim dud sum brgya bstsal to/ /de ltar myang / dbas/ mnon/ tshes pong bcas bzhis spu rgyal la blo dkar byas pas bran g.yog khyim dud mang bo dang / yul chen po la dbang zhing / btsan po'i blon por bcug go zhes sogs byung zhing / de yang〈tun hong yig rnying〉las gsal ba'i lo rgyus gnas tshul de rigs ni bod rgyal gnam ri srong btsan gyi byang 'dul dmag 'thab kyi mdzad pa bkod pa zhig ste/ btsan po de bas thog mar yab stag ri gnyan gzigs kyis ban pa rje dang brang gar rje la sogs pa rgyal phran 'ga' zhig dbang du bsdus pa'i mdzad 'phrin gyi mjug bskyangs te/ dbus phyogs kyi zing po rje dbang du bsdus nas bzhugs gnas kyang phying ba stag rtse nas yar klung gtsang bo'i byang phyogs su spos te chab srid kyi lte gnas mal gro'i pho brang byams pa gling du mdzad pa dang / phyis gtsang rgyal po mar mun dang / dwags po sa khul sogs kyang mnga' khongs su 93

bcug ste bod dbus gtsang gcig gyur dang rgyal srid mnga' khongs rgya skyed kyi rmang gzhi ci tsam btings na'ang / shar nub byang gang sar glo bur mnga' khongs rgya skyed drags pa'am/ byas rjes can gyi dmag dpon so sor sa khul dang mi ser gyi bya dga' byin drags pa'am/ yang na mi lo stong phrag du ma'i ring rgyal phran sil ma kha thor gyis sa cha bcad bzung byas nas phan tshun rgol res byed pa'i lam srol gyi bag chags ci rigs shig gi rkyen pas phyi nang gang sar srid dbang gi rmang gzhi sra zhing brtan pa zhig 'dzugs thub po rang byung med pas/ sku tshe'i smad la dwags po dang /kong po/ myang po la sogs pa'i yul de dag tu bran g.yog bdag po rnams kyis phan tshun ngan 'brel gyis tshur rgol byed pa'i rigs dang / sa thag ring ba'i zhang zhung dang mdzo sum pa sogs rgyal phran tsho ba 'ga' zhig kyang ngo log par byed pa'i rigs byung bar ma zad/ tha na nang 'khor ngan pa nyung shas kyis dgra bo dang ngan pa lag 'brel gyis zas dug phul nas bkrongs pa bcas〈tun hong yig rnying〉nang du'ang btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i ring la yab 94

'bangs n-i 'khus/ yum 'bangs n-i log gnyen zhang zhung / mdzo sum pa/ nyag ny-i dwags po/ rkong po myang po kun kyang log yab gnam ṛ slon mtshan dug bon te bkrongs so zhes gsal bar 'khod yod/gnas tshul de lta bu'i 'og gnam ri srong btsan gyi sras srong btsan dgung lo bcu gsum lon pa'i tshe blon chen myang mang bo rje zhang snang dang mgar mang zham sum snang / khyung po spung sad zu tse/dbas dbyi tshab la sogs pas zhabs nas btegs te btsan po'i khri la mnga' gsol zhing / de nas bzung btsan po 'di bas zhi drag gi thabs gang rung zhig la brten nas byang shar du yod pa'i sum pa dang 'a zha sogs chab 'bangs su bcug par ma zad/ yab mes kyi dgongs gzhi ltar bod khams gcig gyur dang 'bangs rnams bde bar skyong ba'i ched du bod dbus 'gyur gyi ljongs 'dir yul gyi bkod pa dang sa'i dpyad pa sogs la brtag dpyad kyis blon po rnams dang bka' gros thog da lta'i pho brang po ta la chags yul dmar po ri 'di nyid sa dpyad khyad du 'phags par gzigs nas 95

der pho brang mtho la btsan pa zhig bzhengs nas bod yongs la dbang bsgyur ba'i mdun sa chen po 'dzugs par mdzad do//de yang pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling ni bod rgyal gnam ri srong btsan gyis phyag btab cing srong btsan sgam po'i 'khrungs yul yin pa tsam du ma zad/ gnam ri srong btsan nas srong btsan sgam po'i sku che'i stod bar gyi chab srid rten gzhi gtso bo zhig tu'ang gyur yod pas/ pho brang de'i gna' shul gyi sa 'og nas rnyed pa'i dngos rdzas gang zhig la'ang rig dngos kyi rin thang chen po ldan pa zhig yin tsa na/ de las rnyed pa'i rdor brkos kyi mig mangs rtse gzhi de yang shin tu rtsa che ba'i btsan po'i dus kyi lo rgyus kyi dpang rtags shig yin par sus kyang bsnyon du med/des na hor khang byams pa bstan dar lags nas rdor brkos kyi mig mangs rtse gzhi de'i skor khu bo nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med lags la bka' 'dri zhus pa'i lan du/ phyag gsal gcung nyid spyi lo1999lor rgya mar phebs te skabs der gnas nang pho brang byams pa gling gi gna' shul nas thon pa'i rdor brkos mig 96

mangs mig bcu bdun byas pa zhig gzigs byung nas gong rim la snyan seng gis da lta rdor brkos mig mangs rtse gzhi de bod ljongs rten mdzod khang gis bdag gnyer zhib 'jug byed mus yin pa de ni gna' rdzas chud zos ma song ba khyed rang nas byas rjes chen po bzhag gnang 'dug nga rang la mig mangs mig17pa de bed spyod dang 'byung khungs skor bka' 'dri gnang ba de ni 'os shing 'tsham pa red la/ nga rang la'ang gnad don de 'dra zhig 'phrad myong ba stabs bde zhig zhu rgyur/ nga rang chung dus lo27nas mdo spyi dza sag bla ma thub bstan mchog ldan dang / zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan rnam gnyis kyis las bya mdo smad phogs khang lo bzhi byed ring sde dge phyi 'brog dang / ri bo che chos gling 'brog pa gnyis shar nub sa 'dres yin pas rtswa ra'i skor rtsod gleng gis mi bsad 'khrug rkyen byung bar mdo spyi dza sag rnam gnyis kyi bka' bzhin nga rang gyod gzhi thag gcod byed par sa gnas su bskyod skabs rtsod gleng ha cang che zhing / phyogs gnyis ka'i bar gnas brtsi 'jog byed pa'i bla ma mtshan ldan zhig nas gsung don sde dge 97

phyi 'brog dang / ri bo che chos gling gnyis kyi sa mtshams der rdo pha bong chen po zhig yod pa de'i steng du snga rabs gling rje ge sar rgyal po dang / 'brug mo gnyis spro 'cham la phebs dus mig mangs skyon sa'i 'khrab gzhi ched brkos shig yod pa de 'brog pa khag gnyis kyi sa mtshams yin pa sngar nas bshad srol yod lugs gsung don ltar/ phan tshun gnyis kyi 'thus mi khrid de nga rang sa gnas de gar lta zhib tu ched bskyod skabs/ rdo pha bong gru bzhi'i 'dra gzugs kyi steng du mig mangs 'khrab gzhi mig bcu bdun byas pa ha cang gsal bo brkos 'dug pas snga rabs nas bod la mig mangs mig bcu bdun byas pa dar srol yod pa'i ra 'phrod gsal rjen 'dug khar/ nga rang lo nany-inibar nas mig mangs rtsed kyi yod pas 'brel yod sku drag dang / skabs de dus lha sa'i bar skor nang mig mangs mkhas grags yod pa'i kha che tshong pa kha shas dang / rgya rigs dang hu'e rigs kha shas yod pa mnyam du mig mangs rol rtsed byed myong bas skabs de dus mig mangs mig17byas pa kho na red/ da lta'i mig19byas pa bod zhi bas bcings 'grol byung 98

rjes dar ba las de sngon mthong thos med nges bcas dgro/ngas 'jags 'di gar gsung 'os rigs sngar bzhin lhug stsol yod pa zhu zhes sogs gsal/gong gsal 'phrin yig gi brjod don dang mthun pa'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha 'ga' zhig yod pa de dag gi brjod don dag kyang mdor bsdus kyi tshul du brjod na/1 yan krin krung gis brtsams pa'i〈dkar nag gi 'jig rten〉zhes pa'i nang bon dpe las drangs pa'i gtam rgyud dum bu zhig ste/ sngon sangs rgyas chos lugs bod la ma dar ba'i gong gi dus gcig na/ byis pa zhig gi pha ni pha rol dgra bos lnga ba'i lam du btang / nam zhig gi tshe bu de nyid nar son rjes pha yi dgra sha bus len par 'dod/ 'on kyang dus la bab min mig mangs brtses nas brtags pas rgyal ba ltar dgra sha lag tu lon thub pa byung zhes 'khod/2 sku zhabs phe rin pa ran gyis brtsams pa'i〈'dzam gling yang rtse'i mig mangs〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig nang rgyal dbang sku phreng 99

lnga ba dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim rjes/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang lha bzang han gnyis bar gyi dbang cha'i 'gal zla je cher song yang / phan tshun gnyis ka'i dmag shugs do mnyam du gnas stabs/ drag shugs la brten pa tsam gyis rang gzhan gnyis ka 'phung rgyu las gzhan yong rgyu gang yang med pa phyogs gnyis kas shes kyi yod par brten/ zhi ba'i lam nas mig mangs 'gran te rgyal pham thag gcod rgyur phan tshun gnyis ka mos mthun nas mig mangs lan gsum 'gran pas sangs rgyas rgya mtshor pham kha phog par ma zad/ mthar1705lor lha bzang han gyis sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho bgrongs pa sogs kyi don rkyen byung stabs/ phyis bod pa rnams kyis mig mangs ni bkra mi shis pa'i dngos po zhig tu brtsis nas rtse ba la 'dzems pa'i nyer len la brten nas de'i rtse lugs kyang nyams dmas su phyin pa'i skor dang / de bzhin spyi lo 1959lo'i zla4pa'i tshes2nyin 'bras ljongs rgyal bu dang nyi hong gi mig mangs ched las pa'i bar mig mangs mig17྾17byasapa de nyid 'gran sdur byas tshul 'khod pa dang sbrags phyogs gnyis 100

kas g.yul gra ji ltar bsgrigs tshul gyi dpe ris kyang gsal bar bkod yod/3 〈 krung go'i mig mangs〉zhes pa'i dus deb kyi rtsom sgrig pa khreng zha'o li'u yis kyang dus rabs gcig tsam gyi nang tshun du/bod kyi mig mangs la gzhi rtsa'i 'gyur ldog gang yang byung med cing / bod du rnyed pa'i snga dus kyi mig mangs phal cher gna' rabs kyi skye bo rnams kyis brag rdo'i thog tu brkos pa'i mig17྾17byas pa zhe gcig yin cing / deng dus su'ang si khron dang mtsho sngon gyi rgya che'i bod rigs sa khul du rig rgyu yod par ma zad/ sa gnas de ga'i dmangs khrod du'ang mig mangs dang 'brel ba'i gtam rgyud 'ga' zhig shod rgyu yod la/ 'brog pa tshos ni sa gnas de gar gnas pa'i mig mangs ni lo ngo stong phrag tsam gyi gong du byon pa'i bod rigs kyi dpa' bo gling rje ge sar rgyal po brtses myong ba zhig yin par brjod srol yod lugs bstan 'dugade yang gong gsal gyi dpyad gzhi dag las nga tshos nges shes gsal bo zhig rnyed thub pa ni/ rang cag bod la dus snga mo zhig 101

nas mig mangs mig17྾17byas pa de rigs rtse rgyu yod par ma zad/ phyis 'bras ljongs sogs nye 'khor gyi yul gru de rigs la mched de dar khyab song ba la sogs pa ni lo rgyus kyi gnas tshul dngos so//de bzhin mig mangs zhes pa'i tha snyad skor la dpyad na'ang /de ni ma mthar mi lo chig stong bzhi brgya lhag tsam gyi gong nas bed spyod byed pa'i tha snyad cig yin na'ang / phyis lo rgyus 'phel rim gyi nang skad gdangs la 'pho 'gyur phyin pa'i dbang gis yi ge'i gzugs la'ang 'gyur ba cung zad byung ba ste/ dper na sngar gyi tun hong yig cha'i nang myig mangs zhes byung yang / phyis mig mangs sam mig mang du 'gyur ba tshang mas mthong gsal ltar yin zhing / myig mangs sam mig mangs zhes pa'ang gzhi rtsa rtse gzhi'i sgo nas thogs pa'i tha snyad cig yin pa la the tshom bya dgos med na'ang / mig ces pa rtse gzhi'i steng gi re'u mig dang / mangs zhes pa rtse gzhi'i steng du mig gang tsam mang ba de tsam gyis rde'u yang mangs dgos pas brtse bya'i rtse gzhi dang rtse byed rde'u gnyis ka'i sgo 102

nas thogs par byas na don dngos dang mthun che bar snyam mo/ /'on kyang la las mig mangs zhes pa'i bod yig gi dag char bsam gzhigs ye nas ma byas par mig dmag ces dbang bo mig la brten nas dmag rgyag par ngos 'dzin byas pa de ni lta rgya thos rgya chung ba'i skyon kho nar zad do//gzhan yang bod kyi mig mangs la so so'i khyad chos ldan pa'i brda chad 'ga' zhig kyang byung ba ste/ mig mangs kyi rtse gzhi'i zur bzhi la rtse bzhi dang / mig mangs dngos gzhi mgo ma tshugs sngon la phyogs so so nas sa mtshams dbye 'byed kyi byed nus ldan pa'i rde'u drug re btsugs pa la spo zhes dang / rtse gzhi'i dkyil dbus su gnas pa'i lte ba'i mig la gung zhes dang / rde'u rnams rtse gzhi'i mig gi steng du brgyag pa la ju rgyag pa zhes sogs mang du yod cing / de dag ni brda gsar rnying ngam yul skad kyi khyad par dbang gis skye bo so sor go bde mi bde sna tshogs 'byung srid kyang bod kyi tha snyad cig yin pa la sus kyang bsnyon du med/gzhan yang mig mangs rtse lugs kyi goms gshis thad sku 103

zhabs dom po ba thub bstan rgyal mtshan lags dang go bsdur bgyis pa brgyud gsal kha byung bar gzhigs na/ bod la yul gru gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i goms srol 'ga' zhig yod pa ste/thog mar rde'u dkar nag gnyis so so nas rtse gzhi'i rtse gnyis re bzung ba dang sbrags thig gsum pa'i mtha' skor du spo zhes rde'u che ba drug re 'dzugs dgos pa yin la/ de nas res mos byas te ju brgyag dgos pa dang / de yang phan tshun gnyis ka rig stobs do mnyam min na zhan pa des brgya chag sogs rde'u grangs mang nyung sna tshogs kyi chag yang zhu srol yod la/ do mnyam yin tshe snga gzhug shan 'byed dgos shing / de yang shan 'byed skabs rde'u dkar nag gnyis rtse gzhi'am rtse stan gyi steng du rtses te kha sbub pa gang yin sngon la rtse dgos pa yin la/ sngon la rtse mkhan gang yin pa der ma mthar yang rde'u phyed ka gcig 'thob par nges te/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang mig mangs mig17྾17byas pa der khyon mig289yodal/mig289la gzhigs pas rde'u yang289dgos pa yin na/ kha gtad so sor rde'u144 5dbang bas/ mthar de'u phyed ka gcig ye nas 104

gnas thabs med par brten/ de'u145'thob mkhan der don dngos su pha rol gyi rde'u phyed ka gcig las thob med pa lta bu yin pas so/ /de nas dngos su ju rgyag pa'i lam la 'jug dgos pa dang /ju rgyag srol la yang khyad chos lta bur rtse gzhi'i rtse mtshams su rde'u drug gis mig gnyis chags par byed pa der rtse la nya mo drug chags dang / mtha' lcags kyi mtshams su rde'u brgyad kyis mig gnyis chags par byed pa der mda' la shwa ba brgyad chags dang /gnas gang rung zhig tu rde'u nyis gshibs su gnas pa der mig mangs de'u nyis gshibs la/ /glang chen dar ma'i srog skar gnas/ /zhes pa sogs yod pa tsam du ma zad/ spyir btang gi ju la rtse ju'am ltag ju dang / spyi ju'am dkyil ju/ am ju/ og ju sogs yod la/ ju skyen pa'i rigs la rgyang ju dang ju ngan pa'i rigs la bong ju zhes pa sogs kyang yod par ma zad/ thig gi steng du bsam mno gtong rgyur rde'u gcig kha bslangs nas bzhag pa der bsam rdo zhes pa sogs mang bas zhib par lag len dngos las shes par bya rgyu gal che zhing / rgyal pham brtsi ba'i lam srol 105

la yang dmigs bsal khyad chos 'ga' zhig mchis pa ste/ dper na/ pha rol po'i lde'u dkyil du rang gi de'u'i gcig shi na der a ya'o bton pa zer zhing de lan der 'jal bya mi chog pas lan gcig sa cha gzhan du ju rgyag par 'gro dgos pa dang / mig mangs rtse mur rang nyid pham bzo yod tshe mig mangs bya ba ngan pas 'phro la zhog ces stabs bstun g.yo thabs kyis pha rol po sa cha gzhan du khrid de nyen kha las g.yol thabs byed pa/ sa cha der rgyag yul med tshe phan tshun gnyis ka mnyam chags la 'jog srol yod pa bcas/ mig mangs gcad dang gcod pa mkhas/ /gcad gcod mang na rang nyid 'phung / /zhes pa ltar/ gal te rang skal gyi rtse mo gnyis po dang spyi la dbang ba'i gung gcig pu de pha rol por shor na rtse bcad gung bcad ces khyon rde'u grangs25shor bar brtsi srol yod pa lta bu mang ngo / /de bzhin bod kyi sa cha la lar mig mangs rtse skabs phyogs gnyis ka nas babs bstun gyis kha shags rgyag pa'i srol yang yod par grags la/ kha shags kyi brjod bya'ang rde'u rnams gcan gzan dang 'dab chags sogs la 106

dpe sbyar nas gdul bya 'dul byed kyi sgo nas dpa' gtam shod pa lta bur song gshis/ des thad kar mig mangs rtse rtsal la shugs rkyen gang yang mi thebs na'ang / de'i thog nas mig mangs 'di bzhin sho dang 'dra bar bod mi rigs kyi thun min khyad chos ldan pa'i rtsed rigs shig yin pa ra sprod byed thub bo//de yang brgya bshad brgya la bshad kyang yos la 'bab rgyu rtsam pa zhes pa'i dpe ltar mjug sdom lam tsam byas na/ mig mangs 'di bzhin gna' nas da bar gangs ri'i ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i mtho sgang gi sa gzhi 'dir dmigs bsal gyi lus khams kyi khyad nus dang thun min gyi blo rig la brten nas 'tsho sdod byed pa'i bod mi rigs kyis dga' bo bya ba'i rtsed mo'i rnam grangs shig yin par ma zad/ dmangs khrod kha rgyun du yang mig mangs rde'u ni g.yo sgyu che zhes mig mangs ni ha cang rtogs par dka' ba'i tshad du ngos 'dzin pa ltar/ de'i shes bya'i rnam grangs de dag kyang glo bur du grub pa zhig min par rtsis dang rig pa la brten nas rim gyis byung ba zhig yin na/ bod kyi rig gnas kyi thog ma'i gzhi rtsa 107

yang sa skyes rdo skyes kyi bon gyi rig gnas la thug yod pa ltar/mig mangs kyi lo rgyus ring tshad dang dmangs khrod du dar ba'i mig mangs skor gyi ngag rgyun gang la bltas na'ang / de ni bon gyi rig gnas dang 'brel nas byung ba zhig yin par gor ma chag pas/ de skor zhib 'jug dpyis phyin pa zhig byed thub na/ bod kyi shes rig spyi'i zhib 'jug gi bya gzhag 'thus sgo tshang zhing gong du 'phel rgyur phan rlabs chen po yong nges pas/ da lam kho bos kyang sngar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs sa'i pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi gna' shul nas rnyed son byung ba'i rdor brkos kyi mig mangs rtse gzhi der zhib 'jug bgyis pa'i dpyad rtsom 'di bris pa lags shing / de'i nying dgos kyang deng tang dang srid gzhung nas mi rigs kyi rig dngos gna' shul srung skyob kyi srid jus dang thabs shes rab dang rim pa bton na'ang / sa gnas dngos thog tu phyi nang gi rgyu rkyen ri/nga rung zhig gi dbang gis lag len don 'khrol dpyis phyin pa zhig yong dka' bar brten/ rig dngos rku 'tshong dang gna' shul meg med du 'gro ba'i gnas tshul yang thon 108

dang thon mus yin stabs/ rim pa so so'i do dam las byed pa rnams kyis gcig nas tang dang srid gzhung gi re ba chud zos su mi 'gro ba dang /gnyis nas pha mes kyis bzhag pa'i rtsa che'i nor bu bor brlag tu mi 'gro ba/ gsum nas rang nyid kyi lto phogs dang rgyu dag la 'gan 'khyer ba bcas kyi sgo nas sa gnas kyi me mda' 'ben la phog par byas te/ rig dngos sne gcig dang / gna' shul khang mig gcig tsam yang bor brlag 'thor skyon spu tsam med par srung skyob do dam tshags tshud po zhig yong rgyur skul 'ded kyi nus pa thon thub par bsams te/ nye lam bdag med du lus pa'i sngar chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po 'khrungs sa'i pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi gna' shul gyi sa 'og nas rnyed son byung ba'i rnor brkos kyi mig mangs rtse gzhi 'di lta bu'i rig dngos sne gcig pu de tsam la yang bod kyi chos dang rig gnas kyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug gi rin thang ci 'dra ldan min gsal bshad byed pa zhig yin pas/ des kyang bod kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel/ gsar gtod yar 'phel bcas yong rgyur phan 109

nus til 'bru tsam zhig thon thub pa byung na/ ngal ba chung ngu la'ang 'bras bu chen po zhig thob song snyam ste ngos kyi lag tu 'chang ba'i rgya sgyug dkar po'i blo kha yang de gas rdzogs nges lags so//dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs/1 chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs dang nor brang o rgyan gyis rtsom sgrig byas shing bod ljongs bod yig dpe rnying dpe skrun khang nas1990lor par du bskrun pa'i〈bod kyi lo rgyus rags rim g.yu yi phreng ba〉(stod cha)zhes pa'i bod yig par gzhi/2 nam mkha'i nor bus brtsams shing krung go'i bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang nas1996lo'i zla5par par du bskrun pa'i 〈zhang bod lo rgyus ti se'i 'od〉ces pa'i bod yig par gzhi/3 a ri'i mig mangs zhib 'jug pa phi thā she'u thar gyis brtsams shing bsod nams chos rgyal gyis rtsom sgyur byas te〈bod ljongs slob che'i rig deb〉(1994lo'i dus deb gnyis pa)thog bkod pa'i〈bod kyi mig mangs la dpyad pa〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig110

4 a ri'i mig mangs zhib 'jug pa phe rin pa ran gyis brtsams shing bsod nams chos rgyal gyis bsgyur te〈bod ljongs zhib 'jug〉(1994lo'i rgya yig dus deb)deb gsum pa'i thog bkod pa'i〈'dzam gling yang rtse'i mig mangs〉zhes pa'i rtsom yig5 〈tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus yig cha phyogs sgrig〉sogs yod/ 111

'gyig gi rnam gzhag dang de'i khyad chos mdor bsdus/ting 'dzin bkra shis/spyir na 'gyig ni bod yongs la dar khyab yod pa'i srol rgyun gyi rtsed mo'i bye brag cig yin pa dang / khyad par du mdo smad dang khams phyogs su dar khyab shin tu che/ rtse stangs mang zhing 'phel la/mang tshogs kyis dga' zhen byed pa/ bod kyi rig gnas kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal ba'i rtsed mo zhig yin pas/ rong 'brog sa khul gyi rgya che mang tshogs kyis gung gseng skabs dang las zhor ngal gso byed skabs rgan dar gzhon gsum mnyam du tshogs te 'gyig gdan dang 'gyig rde'u gang 'dzoms btsal nas 'gyig gi rtsed mo la rol bar byed/ de bas 'gyig ni bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i cha shas su gyur yod pa dang rtse stangs thad nas kyang bod kyi srol rgyun 112

rig gnas khyad chos mngon yod pas der zhib 'jug dang dpyad pa cung zad btang na spyir bod kyi rig gnas gong 'phel dang /khyad par bod 'gyig gi rig gnas de 'dzam gling gi rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan pa'i rtse rigs de dag ji bzhin rgya khyab tu 'gro bar phan re'i kun slong rnam dag bcangs nas bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas 'gyig la dpyad pa mdo tsam byas/ de yang 'gyig gi rtse stangs rnam gzhag ste/ 'gyig gi 'jog stangs/ 'ded stangs/'gyig rgyag stangs dang / rde'u za stangs/ spyi khyab tu dar che ba'i 'gyig sna tshogs kyi rnam grangs/ 'gyig gi khyad chos/ bzhi 'gyig dang 'dra 'brel yod pa'i rde'u bu'i rtsed mo gzhan mtshams sbyor/zhar byung bcas khag du mar phyes nas cung zad bshad par bya/dang po/ 'gyig gi rnam gzhag spyir bshad/spyir 'gyig gam bzhi 'gyig gi grub cha gtso bo la 'gyig gdan dang 'gyig rde'u gnyis yod pa las dang po 'gyig gdan ni shing pa dang / rdo leb/ pags pa sogs che chung gi tshad gzhi ma nges pa'i 113

ngos mnyam dngos po'i steng sred cing thig shar bris yod pa la zer zhing /thig shar gyi mang nyung thad la thig shar bcu gsum can dang /dgu can/ bdun can sogs rnam pa sna tshogs yod mod/ thig shar gyi mang nyung ni gtso bo rtse mkhan 'gyig pa'i dga' kha goms phyogs dang / 'gyig rtse ba'i dus yun gyi ring thung / 'gyig de'u dang 'gyig gdan gyi cha rkyen 'dzoms min la bstun nas gdam ga byed/ thig shar la mang nyung gang yod kyang rtse stangs thad nas ha lam gcig pa yin pas/ thig shar bcu gsum can dang / bdun can/ yang na brgyad can sogs gang rtse yang de'u mang nyung tsam las rtse stangs thad mi mthun pa cher med do//spyir btang du thig shar bcu gsum can ni dar khyab shin tu che bas rtse mkhan cung mang / 'gyig gdan dkyil dbus kyi dra mig thog la 'phred thig gcig yod pa de la gseg mig zer/de'u mang nyung grangs tshad ni 'gyig gdan steng gi thig shar gyi rjes su 'jug ldog byed cing / thig shar bcu gsum can rtse na rde'u dkar nag bsdoms pas brgya dang dgu bcu go dgu yod pas rde'u 114

dkar nag phyogs re la rde'u dgu bcu go brgyad re yod pa dang /thig phreng dgu can rtse na rde'u dkar nag bsdoms pas brgya tham pa yod pa dang phyogs re la rde'u lnga bcu tham pa re yod pa dang / thig phreng bdun can rtse na de'u dkar nag phyogs gnyis la bsdoms pas rde'u brgyad cu gya drug yod pa dang phyogs re la rde'u bzhi bcu zhe brgyad re yod do//gnyis pa/ 'gyig gi rtse stangs bshad pa/'gyig gi rtse stangs ni 'gyig gi rnam gzhag gi nang don gal che shos yin zhing / der nang gses su rde'u 'jog stangs dang /'ded stangs/ 'gyig rgyag stangs/ de'u za stangs/ 'gyig skal rde'u len tshul bcas go rim lnga yod/gcig rde'u 'jog stangs/ rde'u 'jog stangs ni 'gyig rtse skabs thog mar 'gyig pas rde'u dkar nag 'gyig gdan steng bzhag nas rtsed mo'i mgo rtsom pa'i rim pa yin zhing / 'gyig mgo ji ltar rtsom par blo gsal gyis brtsams pa'i rtsed chas kun dga' 115

nor bu'i bang mdzod las/ de'u dkar rde'u nag gnyis po las/ /'jog pa'i dang po rde'u dkar dang / /'ded pa'i dang po nag po yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ thog mar 'gyig pa gnyis kyis rde'u dkar rde'u nag gang rtse ba'i dbye ba 'byed dgos pa dang / rde'u dkar thob pas thog mar 'gyig gdan dkyil dbus kyi dra mig gi gseg thig gi sne gcig la rde'u dkar gcig bzhag nas rde'u 'jog pa'i mgo rtsom/ de nas de'u nag gis gseg thig gi sne cig shos steng la rde'u nag gcig 'jog pa dang de bzhin rde'u dkar nag gnyis kyis res mos su 'gyig rde'u 'jog pa dang 'gyig gdan gyi kha ma bkang bar 'jog pa der 'gyig gi rnam gzhag las rde'u 'jog pa'i rim pa zer ro//de yang 'jog pa'i skabs su dra mig gcig gi zur bzhi por rde'u dkar po bzhi'am yang na nag po bzhi bzhag na 'jog 'gyig brgyab pa yin/ 'jog 'gyig 'jog ma thub kyang 'gug gu ste dra mig gi gru gsum la de'u dkar gsum mam yang na rde'u nag gsum 'gug gu'i dbyibs su bzhag na rjes su 'ded pa'i skabs su 116

'gyig rgyag sla bas/ 'jog la mkhas pas 'gug gu 'jog /ces —bshad srol yod/ de bzhin 'jog pa'i skabs su rde'u 'jog par 'dod pa'i gnas gang der de'u de bzhag na gong 'og dang g.yas g.yon gung 'grig min te/ rang la phan gnod gang yod pa/ phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi rang phyogs kyi rde'u gzhan rnams dang 'brel chags thub min dang gzhan phyogs kyi rde'u 'gog gcod byed thub min/ rjes su 'ded pa'i skabs su rang gi 'gyig rgyag par 'os kha yod med bcas phyogs so sor bltas nas snga 'dang phyi 'dang brgyab nas 'jog dgos/ gal srid pha rol pos dra mig gcig gi gru gsum la rde'u bzhag ste de'u 'gug gu'i dbyibs bzhag na 'jog 'gyig rgyag grabs byed pa yin pas rang phyogs kyi rde'u gcig gru bzhi pa'i steng bzhag nas 'gyig kha bcad de pha rol por 'jog 'gyig rgyag mi thub pa bya dgos so//der yang rtsed chas kun dga' nor bu'i bang mdzod las/'jog pa bzang bos phyi nas nang la lta//ta len chos 'khor ma ded rang sar grub/ /ces dang / 'jog shes can gyis rde'u gsum bzhag 117

nas rgyag /ces gsungase shing / 'gyig pa bzang bos rde'u 'jog pa'i skabs su 'jog 'gyig 'jog pa dang / bzhag zin pa'i de'u de rnams rjes su 'ded pa'i skabs su ta len dang lha sa chos 'khor sogs 'gyig gi rnam grangs rnam pa sna tshogs las rgyur gung 'grig min la dmigs nas de'u 'jog dra mig gcig gi steng rde'u gsum 'jog pa de yang bzhi 'gyig rgyag pa'i sta gon byas pa yin/de bzhin rde'u 'jog skabs bsam blo zhib mo btang zhing sta gon legs par byas yod na rjes ma 'ded pa'i skabs su 'gyig 'grub sla zhing pha rol las rgyal kha thob kyang sla ba'o/ /rig sgo de dag lag len gyi nyams myong las shes par bya'o//gnyis/ 'gyig 'ded stangs/ rde'u dkar nag phyogs gnyis kyis 'gyig gdan gyi kha bkang bar bzhag rjes 'gyig pa gnyis kyis bzhag zin pa'i 'gyig rde'u 'ded mgo rtsom zhing / thog mar phyogs gnyis kyis 'jog 'gyig brgyab yod med la blta zhing /'jog 'gyig brgyab yod na 'gyig brgyab pa'i 'gyig skal pha rol po'i rde'u nang nas len dgos/'gyig ri tsam brgyab yod na 'gyig 118

skal rde'u de tsam len dgos/ 'gyig skal blangs rjes gzhi nas 'gyig 'ded mgo rtsom par byed/ 'gyig brgyab med na 'gyig gdan dkyil dbus kyi gseg thig sne gnyis kyi de'u dkar nag gnyis de blangs nas gzhi nas 'gyig 'ded mgo rtsom mo/ /gzhan yang kha shas kyis 'jog 'gyig brgyab na'ang 'gyig skal mi len par thad kar 'gyig 'ded mgo rtsom pa'i srol kyang yod do/ /der yang rde'u ji ltar 'ded par blo gsal gyis brtsams pa'i rtsed chas kun dga' nor bu'i bang mdzod du/ 'gyig 'ded bzang bos snga phyi'i za la blta/ /nyis za sum za'i chos 'khor gtor nyen che/ /zhes dang / 'ded shes can gyis de'u gsum ded nas rgyag /ces gsungs pa ltar 'gyig 'ded pa'i skabs spyir na 'ded bya 'gyig de'u de gnas phyogs gang rung la 'ded pa'i skabs su tshigs mig gcig las 'ded mi choga'on kyang de'u 'ded pa'i lam bar du pha rol po'i rde'u yod na pha rol po'i rde'u de'i steng nas mchong zhing zos nas 'ded pa dang / de bzhin rang phyogs de'u 'ded pa'i de'u lam na pha rol po'i de'u gnyis dang / rde'u gsum/ yang na 119

rde'u bzhi sogs yod na de dag gi steng nas rim bzhin mchong zhing zos nas 'ded/ ji ltar za ba'i skor rnams gsham gyi rde'u za stangs bshad pa'i skabs su zhib tu 'chad par bya'o/ /rde'u 'ded skabs su yang de'u gang zhig 'ded dgos pa dang / gnas phyogs gang la 'ded pa/ rde'u de ded na 'gyig rgyag thub min/ pha rol po'i rde'u za thub min/ rde'u de ded na rang phyogs kyi 'gyig kha phyes yod med/ nyis za sum za byed thub min/ pha rol po'i 'gyig gtor thub min/ rang phyogs rde'u de ded rjes pha rol po'i 'gyig kha phyes yod med sogs mdor na de'u de ded na snga phyi gnyis kyi rde'u bab la mjug 'bras gang 'byung dang / phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi rde'u dmag dang gung 'grig min sogs la bltas te bsam blo bzhi gsum bcu gnyis gtong ba dang / blo rtse nyi shu rtsa lnga 'khor nas 'ded dgos so/ /rde'u 'ded pa'i rim pa ni 'gyig pas mthar thug gi rgyal kha thob min la rag las shin tu che ba'i rim pa gal chen zhig yin zhing / 'ded shes na rde'u 'jog pa'i skabs su rang gis nor 'khrul gang bzos yod pa kha gsab 120

byas te mthar thug gi pham kha mi 'ong ba'i blo bkod byed thub/gal srid rde'u 'jog skabs de'u bab bzang bo zhig bzhag yod kyang 'ded ma shes na rde'u bab bzang bo bzhag pa de yang chud zos su 'gro'o//gsum/ rde'u za stangs/ rde'u za ba ni 'gyig 'ded skabs rang phyogs kyi de'u gcig ded nas pha rol po'i rde'u steng nas mchong zhing za ba de la zer zhing / der rang phyogs kyi rde'u 'ded lam du gzhan phyogs kyi rde'u gcig dang /rde'u gnyis/rde'u gsum/de bzhin rde'u bzhi sogs yod pa'i steng nas mchongs nas 'ded thub na pha rol po'i rde'u de rim bzhin gcig za dang / nyis za/sum za/ bzhi za byas pa yin/ nyis za dang / sum za/ bzhi za sogs byed pa ni thig shar gcig gi steng nas drang mor mchongs nas za chog la/ phyogs g.yas g.yon gnyis dang gang phyogs su mchongs nas zos kyang chog nyis za dang / sum za/ bzhi za sogs byed thub na pha rol po'i 'gyig gtor ba dang / pha rol po'i rde'u dpung phye mar brlag thub/ spyir na de'u 'ded stangs dang rde'u za stangs 121

gnyis ni 'ded bya rde'u gcig 'ded pa'i go rim dang ded pa'i rjes 'bras yin pa'i cha nas 'ded stangs dang za stangs gnyis ka 'ded pa'i rim pa'i nang bzhag na mi chog pa med mod/ de gnyis so sor phyes nas bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan ni rang phyogs rde'u 'ded pa la gzhan phyogs rde'u za ba dmigs yul du byas nas 'ded pa dang rang phyogs de'u gung sgrig pa dang 'gyig las pa'i dmigs yul byas nas 'ded pa sogs dmigs yul mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir 'dir go rim gnyis su bzhag nas bshad pa yin no//rde'u za ba ni 'gyig gi rnam gzhag las pha rol las rgyal bar byed pa'i gal che'i thabs shes sam go rim zhig yin pas 'gyig pas snang chung byed mi rung ngo //bzhi/ 'gyig rgyag stangs/ 'gyig rgyag stangs bshad pa la 'gyig gi rnam grangs dang / 'gyig las stangs/ 'gyig rgyag stangs dper brjod bcas gsum/(gcig) 'gyig gi rnam grangs/ spyir 'gyig la sla 'gyig dang dka' 'gyig gnyis yod pa las sla 'gyig ni rde'u grangs nyung 122

bas 'thus pas sgrig sla ba las dang po ba dang spyi khyab tu dar che/dka' 'gyig ni lde'u grangs mang po dgos pa dang sgrig kyang shin tu dka' bas 'gyig pa mkhas pa rnams ma gtogs sgrig dka'o/ /blo gsal gyi rtsed chas kun dga' nor bu'i bang mdzod du 'gyig gi rnam grangs brgyad cu lhag tsam yod par gsungs pa dang / de dag re re bzhin bgrang na/ gseg ta dang / me mda'/ bzhi 'gyigabya rgod sder 'gyig a long rgyab thug lham 'gyig lha sa/ glag mo'i gshog pa/ mi rtag ri mo/ chos 'khor rde'u bzhi ma/ tshags 'khor rde'u dgu 'gyig lnga/ gsum rdor/ rab ldan sgo brgyad/tshags 'gyig rde'u bcu 'gyig drug sgom pa'i gur khang / dpa' bo'i rtse gsum/ gnyis rdor/ bo'u sbrags/ bo'u char/ 'brong mo'i rwa bdar/ rdo rje rgya gram/ hūm̐ khang zur gsum/ sa bdag 'khor lo/ bu mo'i rna lung / tshags 'khor mgo gnyis/ rde'u bu bang rim can/ tshags 'gyig kha mang / tshags 'gyig brang mgotshags 'khor sgo bzhi/ me tog phreng ba/ zur sbrags khram pa 'gyig gcig gsum sbrags lcags nags 'gyig bzhi/ zur 123

sbrags dam pa 'gyig drug zur sbrags gnam lcags thog mda' dgu 'gyig rgod po'i gsum sgrog zur sbrags bzhi mdud/ zur sbrags mdung mo rtse bzhi/ sgo med lcags mkhar gru bzhi/ lha sa'i khyams ra/ bzhi rdor ske 'khyoganyis ta mgo che/sog mo'i ral ba/mdzes ma'i brang rgyan/ 'do ba'i lcags srab/ 'bri mo'i ske char/khram pa'i sbrags 'khor bzhi mdud/ btsan po'i mda' mo zur 'phen/ smyon pa'i zur 'khor lnga sbrags/'dab brgyad pad ma/zur sbrags ra sga'i char 'gyig me tog tshom bu/ gsum sbrags kha sho/rtag brtan g.yung drung / bdud 'dul mchod rten/ bkra shis chos brtsegs/ rno gcod ral gri/ rin chen nor bu'i gter bum/ brgyad 'dud dpal be'u/ btsan rdor 'gyig pa kun thub sogs so//(gnyis/) 'gyig las stangs/ 'gyig las stangs dang 'gyig rgyag stangs ni 'gyig 'ded stangs yin mod/ logs su bkar nas bshad dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ni/ 'gyig las pa dang 'gyig rgyag pa ni gnas skabs su pha rol po'i de'u za thub min tsam ma yin par/124

pha rol po las yongs su rgyal thub min dang mtha' mjug gi rgyal kha thob thub min la thad kar rag las pa'i go rim zhig yin pas so//de yang 'gyig ces pa ni rde'u grangs nges can zhig 'gyig gdan steng la dbyibs ris nges can du bsgrigs nas bzhag pa de la zer/ dper na/ rde'u dkar bzhi 'gyig gdan gyi phyogs gang rung gi dra mig gcig gi gru bzhir bzhag na bzhi 'gyig gcig grub pa dang / de yang rde'u dkar bzhi pa de ded nas 'gyig kha bkang ba der 'gyig rgyag pa zer ba dang / 'gyig pas rang phyogs rde'u 'ded pa dang / pha rol po'i rde'u za ba gnyis brgyud nas 'gyig rgyag pa dang / 'gyig pa mkhas pas thog mar rde'u 'jog pa'i skabs nas 'gyig 'grig min dang 'gyig 'byung thub min la bltas nas rde'u 'jog 'jog pa'i skabs su bzhag pa bzang na/'gyig 'grig sla ba dang / rgyag sla batshodang / de bzhin rgyal kha yang 'thob sla ba'o/ /de yang 'gyig kyang bzhi 'gyig gcig gnyis tsam brgyab pas pha rol las rgyal thub pa ma yin par 'gyig rnam pa sna 125

tshogs las pa brgyud nas mtha' mjug gi rgyal kha 'thob thabs byed dgos/ dper na/ dmag 'khrug rgyag skabs kyang pha rol po'i gnas tshul la gzhigs nas mda' ring dang mda' thung /me skyogs/ lag 'bom/ dug mda' sogs lag cha sna tshogs la brten dgos pa de bzhin 'gyig rtse skabs kyang gseg ta'i 'gyig dang / me mda'i 'gyig bya rgod sder 'gyig a long rgyab thug 'gyig lha sa de'u gsum gyi 'gyig btsan rdor 'gyig pa kun thub sogs 'gyig sna brgyad cu gya lnga tsam yod pa de dag gi 'grub stangs dang de'u mang nyung / dka' sla sogs kun nas mi mtshungs mod gtso bo 'gyig pas gnas skabs su 'gyig gang 'thus dang gang sla/ gang 'byung bsgrigs nas pha rol po las rgyal thabs kyi jus bkod byed dgos/mdor na 'gyig la rnam grangs phun sum tshogs po yod mod/'gyig de dag gi grub cha rde'u mang nyung dang /'gyig kha'i mang nyung /'gyig rgyag byed rde'u grangs/ 'gyig brgyab rjes 'gyig skal de'u grangs bcas pa shin tu mi mtshungs pas 'gyig so so 'grig pa'i 126

dka' sla yang shin tu mi 'dra'o//dper na/bzhi 'gyig la mtshon na/dra mig gcig gi gru gsum na rang phyogs rde'u gsum yod pa der bzhi 'gyig gcig gi 'gyig kha phyes pa yin pa dang / rde'u gcig ded nas 'gyig kha bkang na bzhi 'gyig brgyab pa yin/bzhi 'gyig gcig brgyab rjes pha rol po'i rde'u tshogs las rde'u gcig len dgos pa/ der 'gyig skal zer/ gsal bar dbye na/ bzhi 'gyig gcig rde'u bzhi las grub pa dang / 'gyig kha gcig phyes yod pa dang / 'gyig rgyag byed rde'u gcig yin pa dang / 'gyig brgyab rjes 'gyig skal rde'u gcig len pa yin/ tshags 'khor a ma 'gyig la mtshon na/ rde'u bcu dgos pa dang / der yang 'gyig kha gcig phyes yod pas/rde'u gcig gis 'gyig kha bkang na 'gyig brgyab pa yin/de yang 'gyig kha shas ni 'gyig gnyis dang / gnyis yan chad mnyam du sbrags nas grub yod pas/ 'gyig kha gnyis dang gnyis yan chad phyes yod/ de'i phyir 'gyig rgyag skabs kyang rde'u gnyis dang gnyis yan chad kyis 'gyig kha bkang nas 'gyig rgyag dgos/dper na lham 'gyig lta bur mtshon na rde'u bcu gnyis gshar nas 127

me mda'i 'gyig gnyis mnyam du sbrags yod pa dang / lham 'gyis/ la'ang 'gyig kha gnyis yod phyir rde'u gnyis dus gcig tu ded nas lham 'gyig rgyag pa yin/yang na/ rdo rje rgya gram 'gyig la mtshon na/ bzhi 'gyig lnga'i gru thod gtugs nas grub yod phyir 'gyig kha mang bo phyes yod pa dang rde'u mang bo ded nas 'gyig rgyag dgos/ bu mo rna rgyan gyi 'gyig lta bur mtshon na'ang bzhi 'gyig gnyis kyi gru 'brel yod pa lta bu/gzhan yang sa bdag 'khor lo'i 'gyig lta bur mtshon na/ rde'u lnga bcu nga bdun las grub cing / der nyis 'gyig bcu dang bzhi 'gyig kha shas las grub par ma zad/ dbus na nyis 'gyig bzhi'i kha phyes yod/ 'on kyang 'gyig 'di dus gcig la rde'u bzhi ded nas 'gyig rgyag pa ma yin par thengs rer rde'u gcig ded nas 'gyig re rgyag pa dang / de bzhin rim bzhin du 'gyig thengs bzhir rgyag dgos/ de yang 'gyig kha'i mang nyung las 'gyig rgyag byed rde'u mang nyung yang mi 'dra ba dang / 'gyig kha mang na yang dus gcig tu 'gyig mang rgyag pa'i nges pa med par 'gyig kha mang 128

de re re byas nas mu mthud du rgyag dgos pa lta bu'o//(gsum/) 'gyig rgyag stangs/ 'gyig rgyag stangs la rang phyogs rde'u ded nas 'gyig rgyag pa dang / pha rol po'i rde'u zos nas 'gyig rgyag pa/ rde'u 'phur nas 'gyig rgyag pa sogs rgyag stangs sna tshogs yod/ dang po ded nas rgyag pa'i 'gyig ni lha sa rde'u sgo dar can gyi 'gyig dang gnyis rdor 'gyig lta bur mtshon na/ 'gyig bsgrigs tshar rjes rde'u gcig ded nas 'gyig rgyag dgos pa dang / 'gyig brgyab tshar ba de'i 'gyig kha phyes nas 'gyig yang yang rgyag chogaganyis pa zos nas 'gyig rgyag pa zer ba ni/ rang phyogs rde'u ded nas pha rol po'i rde'u za ba dang dus gcig tu rang gi 'gyig kha bkang nas 'gyig rgyag pa de la zer zhing / der yang kher za byas nas 'gyig rgyag pa/ nyis za byas nas 'gyig rgyag pa/ sum za byas nas 'gyig rgyag pa/ bzhi za byas nas 'gyig rgyag pa sogs yod pa lta bu'o//gsum pa rde'u 'phur nas 'gyig rgyag pa ni 'gyig gi dbyibs 129

ris bsgrigs tshar rjes/ rang phyogs rde'u gcig dang / rde'u gnyis/ rde'u gsum sogs 'gyig kha'i grangs dang mtshungs pa'i rang phyogs rde'u dus gcig tu blangs nas 'gyig rgyag pa la zer/dper na mda' sbrags bzhi 'gyig lta bur mtshon na me mda' gnyis bzhi sbrags byas pa'i sbrags sner bzhi 'gyig gcig gi kha phyes yod pa dang 'gyig 'di bsgrigs tshar rjes gang bsam sa nas rde'u zhig blangs nas 'gyig rgyag chog gzhan yang glag mo gshog 'gyig gi rgyag stangs yang de bzhin no//de nas gong du 'gyig gi rnam grangs brgyad cu las re 'ga' zhig dper brjod tshul du drangs pa yin pa dang / rgyas par yig tshogs la 'jigs nas re re bzhin ma spros shing zhib tu lta 'dod na dge rgan blo gsal lags kyis mdzad pa'i rtsed chas kun dga' nor bu'i bang mdzod la gzigs par 'tshal/(bzhi/) 'gyig skal rde'u len pa'i skor/bu'agyig skal rde'u len stangs/ 'gyig re re brgyab rjes pha rol po'i rde'u tshogs las 'gyig brgyab pa'i 'gyig skal rde'u len 130

dgos/ 'gyig skal len pa ni rang phyogs nas 'gyig brgyab pa'i grub 'bras rtsis len dang pha rol po'i dpung shugs gtor thabs byed pa de yin phyir/ 'gyig skal rde'u len skabs kyang rde'u gang rung len pa ma yin par/ pha rol po'i rde'u dpung las gnad che sa ste dper na ta len 'gyig dang chos 'khor sogs gtor thub sa dang / rang phyogs kyi 'gyig bsgrig sla ba'i 'os kha gang 'grig gang 'tshams yod sa nas len dgos/ 'gyig gi rnam grangs mi 'dra ba'i phyir na 'gyig skal rde'u mang nyung yang mi 'dra/ dper na bzhi 'gyig la 'gyig skal de'u gnyis yin pa dang / gnyis 'gyig gcig gi 'gyig skal de'u gnyis yin no//durgyal pham gyi mtha' thag gcod pa/ rde'u dkar nag phyogs gnyis kas phan tshun rde'u za res dang 'gyig rgyag res byas nas phyogs gang rung zhig gi rde'u gsum las med dus phyogs de ni pham par brtsi ba'o//gzhan yang thig shar bcu gsum can rtse dus phyogs gang zhig la rde'u bcu gsum las med dus phyogs der de'u mchongs zer 131

zhing skabs der rde'u 'ded dus rde'u de tshigs re re bzhin 'gro mi dgos par gang bsam sar thengs gcig gis mchongs nas pha rol po'i 'gyig kha gcod pa dang / yang na rang gi 'gyig kha bkang nas 'gyig rgyag pa bcas byed chog pas/ phyogs gang zhig gi rde'u tshar nas rde'u bcu gsum ma gtogs med na yang mtha' gcig tu pham pa'i nges pa med par ma zad/ mtshams rer rgyal kha thob pa yang yod pas 'gyig pa mkhas pas kyang der sprang po'i dbyug pa zhes shin tu bag zon byed do//gsum pa/ 'gyig gi khyad chos bshad pa/gcig yun ring ba'i lo rgyus ldan pa dang bod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal ba ldan pa/ spyir 'gyig ni dus nam zhig nas byung ba'i dus tshigs ni da snga nges gtan byed mi nus mod/ 'on kyang gna' snga mo nas bod rang yul nas byung zhing / dus yun ring ba'i lag len brgyud nas bod rigs kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal ba/ 'gyig gi rnam grangs phun sum 132

tshogs pa/ rtse stangs kyi rnam gzhag zhib tshags che zhing 'thus sgo tshang ba 'di lta bu zhig tu gyur pa yin nges par dpyod ldan rnams kyis cung zad dpyad pas shes sla/de min nye lo du ma'i sngon du rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sku mkhar pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi gna' shul nas rdor brkos mig mangs rtse gzhong srid zheng thig phreng bcu bdun can zhig rnyed byung ba dang / der brtag dpyad byas na rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sku dus kyi gna' rdzas yin pa dang /de'i phyir lo ngo chig stong lnga brgya'i yar sngon nas bod du mig mangs dar yod ces mkhas pa dgra lha zla ba bzang bos gsungs shing / gzhan yang sngon gyi khams sde dge dang chab mdo ri bo che gnyis kyi sa mtshams kyi rdo pha bong zhig gi steng du yang 'gyig gzhong zhig brkos yod pa dang /de ni sngon chad gling rje ge sar rgyal po dang 'brug mo gnyis kyis 'gyig 'ded sa yin zhes sa de ga'i dmangs khrod ngag rgyun du bshad srol yod ces nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med kyis gsungs/ gzhan yang mkhas dbang nam mkha' nor bus kyang mig 133

mangs ni gna' thog mar bon po'i mo rtsis de'u drug las dar ba yin zhes kyang gsungs so/ /der ma zad lo rgyus deb ther rgya bod yig tshang chen mo las/ bod ni mig mangs mkhas zhes dang / tun hong yig rnying las kyang / bod kyi btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i blon po khyung po spung sad zu tse ni dmag thabs dang mig mangs la mkhas zhes bris yod pa sogs dpyad gzhi de dag phyogs bsdus byas nas dpyad na bod du sangs rgyas bstan pa ma dar gong nas mig mangs dar yod pa'i bden dpang ra sprod thub/ de yang 'gyig dang mig mangs gnyis kyi rtse stangs dang rnam gzhag thog nas phan tshun cung mi 'dra mod de gnyis sngon ma nyid nas bod la dar yod pa'i gna' bo'i bod kyi rig gnas bye brag cig yin pa dogs med bsnyon med yin/de yang 'gyig ces pa'i ming 'dogs srol steng nas dpyad na/kha shas kyis 'gyig ces pa de ni yi ge ma dag pa yin/ 'gyig ces pa mdo smad kyi yul skad yin pa dang yig skad du 'grig ces pa yin/ de'i phyir 'grig ces sgyur na dag cha yod do zer ba mi 'thad 134

de/ gal srid 'gyig ces pa de ni 'grig tu btsan bsgyur byas na 'gyig ces pa'i rtsed mo 'di nyid gna' snga mo nas bod du dar yod pa'i rtsed mo'am dmangs khrod rig gnas shig yin pa'i tha snyad kyi bden dpang de nyams 'gro ste/ 'gyig ces pa ni 'grig ces yin par rnga ba'i lo rgyus las gsungs shing / mdo smad kyi kha skad du ga ra btags gya zhes klog pa dang / mi la myi dang gri la gyi zhes pa de tshang ma tun hong gter yig las thon pa'i yig rnying gi klog stangs dang gcig yin/ tun hong gi yi ge de dag ni brda rnying ngam gna' skad cig yin pa dang lo ngo chig stong yan gyi lo rgyus ldan par mkhas pa'i gsung du gsal la/ ma mthar bkas bcad gsum pa yar sngon gyi klog stangs shig yin pa'i dbang du btang na/'gyig ces pa'i tha snyad der ma mthar yang lo ngo bdun brgya brgyad brgya tsam gyi lo rgyus yod par rtags grub tu sla/ de'i phyir nga'i rtsom yig nang 'gyig ces sgra sor bzhag byas yod pa yang yi ger dag cha ma thon pa ma yin par tha snyad kyi lo rgyus bden dpang de sor bzhagarī byed e thub bsam pa yin/ 135

gnyis/ bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khyad chos mngon gsal ldan pa/ dngos po gang zhig yin rung rgyu rkyen dang khor yug la brten nas byung ba dang / 'byung byed rgyu rkyen dang khor yug gi shugs rkyen ni 'byung bya dngos po de nyid kyi steng nas tshur mngon bzhin yod/ de bzhin du 'gyig ni bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khrod nas byung ba yin phyir 'gyig la bod kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i khyad chos mngon gsal mngon rgyu los yod/ thog mar 'gyig gi ngo bo'i thog nas bshad na 'gyig ni blo rig 'gran bsdur byed spyad dang /rtsed mo ku re slong byed/ tha na sos dal dus kyi nyi ma gtong byed kyi rtsed mo zhig yin zhes na mi chog pa med mod/ 'on kyang de'i rtse stangs dang /ming brda tha snyad 'dogs stangs sogs gang thad nas bltas na bod kyi spyi tshogs sam bod mi'i 'jig rten lta tshul dang /legs nyes blang dor la 'jug ldog byed tshul sogs spyi tshogs kyi brjod bya zab mo dag mngon gyi yod/ der ma zad 'gyig gi tha snyad tsam la dpyad na'ang bod kyi 'tsho ba'i khrod kyi rgyun mthong dngos po'i ming btags yod de/ dper na lha sa'i bzhi dar 'gyig ces 136

pa'i nang gi lha sa/'brong mo'i rwa brdar 'gyig ces pa'i 'brong mo/'bri mo'i ske 'char 'gyig ces pa'i 'bri mo dang ske 'char gnyis/rgod po'i gsum sgrog nang gi gsum sgrog zur gsum sngags pa'i hūm̐ khang 'gyig ces pa'i sngags pa dang hūm̐ khang / rdo rje rgya gram 'gyig ces pa'i rdo rje/ bdud 'dul mchod rten 'gyig ces pa'i mchod rten/ rtag brtan g.yung drung 'gyig ces pa'i g.yung drung lta bu 'gyig gi ming brda tha snyad dang dper brjod kyi dngos po brjod kyis mi lang mchis pa rnams ni bod kyi 'tsho ba'i nang mig mthong lag zin gyi dngos po yo byad sha stag yin pas bod rigs kyi spyi tshogs 'tsho ba dang bod kyi rig gnas kyi khyad chos mngon par gsal ba ldan/ de'i phyir 'gyig dang mig mangs ni rgyal khab dang mi rigs gzhan nas mched 'ongs pa ma yin par bod rang sa rang yul nas mched cing dar rgyas byung ba'i srol rgyun rig gnas shig yin pa mtshon gyi yod do//137

bod kyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal myur skyob dang 'dzin skyong byed pa'i skor gyi bsam gzhigagacod pa don grub/bod gangs can pa rnams kyi blo gros kyi rtsal las thon pa'i mig mangs sgyu rtsal ni/ gna' deng gangs ljongs yul du 'tsho bzhugs gnang ba'i bod pa'i srol rgyun gyi dmangs khrod rig gnas mang bo'i dbus su med du mi rung ba'i rig gnas rtsa chen zhig yin la/ de yang che ba bod pa'i btsan po rim byon dang /mkhas dbang rim byon/ chung ba zhing phyugs las gnyer ba'i rong 'brog 'bangs mi dang / tha na bud med dang byis pa rnams kyis kyang rgyun du spro rtsed che ba'i sgyu rtsal khyad par can zhig yin/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i skabs su bkol spyod myong ba'i rdo'i mig gzhong rgyal po'i sku mkhar pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur gling gi gna' 138

shul nas rnyed pa nas brtsis na/ bgrang bya chig stong lnga brgya lhag gi lo rgyus ldan no//de yang lo rgyus kyi chu rgyun ring mo'i nang du bod rigs srol rgyun gyi mig mangs de/ med pa nas yod par chags pa dang yod pa nas rim bzhin rgya je cher gyur te bod khul yongs su sa khyab rdo khyab tu song bar mchis shing / da lta nged cag gis mdo dbus khams gsum du nang don phun sum tshogs shing rtse thabs sna mang 'dus pa'i mig mangs kyi rigs la yang gang mang yod pa mthong 'dug dper na bcir 'gyigarjodang nya 'gyig rgyal po dang blon po'i 'gyig spyang ki dang lug 'gyig bzhi 'gyig drug 'gyigabadun 'gyig dgu 'gyig yang na/ 14྾14can dang /17྾17can/ 19྾19can gyi mig mangs kyang mang bo yod pa sus kyang mthong ba bsnyon du med/ bod pa'i mig mangs zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi rgyal spyi'i mkhas pa dang rgyal nang gi mkhas pa rnams kyis zhib 'jug gnang ba ltar na/ bod rigs kyi mig mangs sam 'gyig ni rgyal spyi dang rgyal nang gi mi rigs gzhan dang 139

rgyal khab gzhan gyi mig mangs las sngon thon yin par gdeng 'jog mthon po gnang 'dugayin na'ang rang re'i yul khams 'di bcings pa las grol rjes lhag par du dus skabs gsar ba'i tshong ra'i dpal 'byor gyi gnas tshul gsar ba dang 'gan 'khur gsar ba'i 'og tu/ deng rabs kyi rig gnas gsar ba dang 'phrul chas sna mang gis mi rnams kyi blo rig 'phrog pa ltar/ mi rigs rang gi srol rgyun rig gnas 'di 'dzin skyong dang mthong chen bgyid pa snang med du bskyur ba dang / yang na dmangs khrod kyi srol rgyun rig gnas la la snum zad kyi mar me bzhin nyams la nye ba dang 'jig par nye bar gyur 'dug dper na/ nged cag gis rtog dpyod byas pa ltar na mtsho sngon po'i khor yug gi 'brog pa mang bo las rang lo bzhi bcu man gyi 'brog pas mig mangs mang che shos rtse mi shes shing / byis pa dang bud med la mtshon na mig mangs sam 'gyig ces pa bod rang gi srol rgyun sgyu rtsal zhig yin pa yang mi shes/ gal te nged cag gis mig mangs sam 'gyig 'di nyams pa sor chud dang ma 140

nyams 'phel rgyas su btang ste/ 'dzin skyong spel gsum legs po zhig ma byas na/ mi 'gyang bar ming gi lhag ma tsam du 'gyur rgyu ni gdon mi za'o//de yang tang gi tshogs chen skabs bcu drug pa'i thog tu rig gnas shul bzhag dang phul du byung ba'i dmangs khrod sgyu rtsal gal chen dag myur skyob dang srung skyong / rgyun 'dzin bya rgyu ni las don gal chen zhig tu bzhag nas 'char gzhi bzos yod cing / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis〈 rang rgyal gyi dngos po ma yin pa'i rig gnas shul bzhag srung skyob bgyi ba'i skor la shugs snon rgyag dgos pa'i bsam 'char〉zhes pa'i yig cha gal chen spel/ yig cha gal chen 'di dag gcig rjes gnyis mthud ngang spel ba 'dis/bod khul yongs kyi lo rgyus ring ba'i dngos po ma yin pa'i rig gnas shul bzhag gam gzugs med kyi rig gnas shul bzhag 'di dag myur skyob dang 'dzin skyong bgyi ba'i thad la phan 'bras bsam gyis mi khyab pa thon 'dug mnyam 'brel rgyal tshogs tshan slob rig gsum gyi rtsa 'dzugs kyis kyang〈 dngos po ma yin pa'i 141

rig gnas shul bzhag srung skyob bgyi ba'i chings yig〉ces spel bas kyang 'dzam gling steng gi rgyal khab so so dang mi rigs so so'i rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen dag myur skyob dang 'dzin skyong bya ba'i thad du blang bya nan mo bton pa 'dir rgyang ring gi mdzub ston rang bzhin gyi don snying gal chen ldan pa red/nged cag rnams kyis shes gsal ltar/ dngos po ma yin pa'i rig gnas shul bzhag rtsa chen ni/ mi rigs shig gi snying stobs dang brtse sems 'ching ba'i mtshon rtags gtso bo zhig yin la/rgyal khab gcig gyur dang mi rigs mthun sgril gyi ka rdo lta bu'i rmang gzhi dang mi'i rigs kyi blo gros kyi nying bcud kyang yin zer chog yin na'ang 'dzam gling dpal 'byor gcig gyur can dang deng rabs can gyi 'dzugs skrun sna mang spel ba'i go rim khrod/dngos po ma yin pa'i rig gnas shul bzhag gi rten gzhi dang khor yug bcas pa lo rgyus steng sngar byung ma myong ba'i 'gyur ldog chen po dang / 'bangs mi'i 'tsho ba'i spyod thabs dang mi tshe'i lta ba dang rin thang lta ba bcas kyang 'gyur ldog blo yid las 'das pa byung 142

stabs/ bgrang bya stong phrag du ma'i sngon la dar ba'i srol rgyun gyi rig gnas skor zhig nyams dang nyams bzhin mchis/ de bas nged cag gis blo sems 'gyur med kyis lo rgyus kyi 'gan lci 'di phrag tu 'khur rgyu ni smos ma dgos pa'i 'os 'gan no//da lta nged rnams kyi mig gi dga' ston du gyur pa'i mig mangs ni/ gna' ba'i lo rgyus yig cha las bstan pa ltar na/ bod gna' rabs kyi mo dang rtsis kyi cho ga'i khrod du byung ba'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin zer zhing / de yang thog mar rgyal po'i pho brang nas dar zhing rim gyis dmangs khrod kyi 'bangs mi'i khrod du dar khyab byung /mig mangs ni spro rtsed tsam la rol ba min par/ de'i nang nas bod kyi rig gnas kyi sna ga mi nyung ba bsags shing 'dus yod/ de ni krung go'i rgya mi rigs kyi mig mangs(be chi)zer ba'i byung 'phel la 'brel ba dam po mchis la/ mdo dbus mtho sgang bod kyi khyad 'phags can dang gsang ba'i rig gnas kyang nang du 'dus 'dugalo rgyus deb ther mi nyung ba'i nang du bod rigs kyi mig mangs rtse ba'i gnas tshul bkod 'dug dper na/ rgya'iṭwāṃ thang yig〉ces pa 143

las/ bod pa mig mangs rtse bar spro ba shin tu che zhes bkod yod/bod kyi gna' dpe mang bo las rgyal po'i pho brang du mig mangs rtse ba'i srol dang dar khyab pa'i lo rgyus kyang bkod pa sus kyang mthong ba ltar ro//khyad par du gling rje ge sar rgyal po'i sgrung gi nang du gling ge sar rgyal po dang blon po sogs lhan du mig mangs rtse ba'i lo rgyus gang mang bkod 'dug dper na/ 〈hor gling g.yul 'gyed〉stod cha las/ de yang nyin re bzhin lcags ra rtse dgu'i yang steng du bzhugs gdan bkod cing blon po phying sngon can dang dpon g.yog gnyis nas/ sho mig mangs kyi sku rtsed la nyi ma ci 'alhokha mdzad cing yod par/ de'i nangs mo rgyal po seng chen de nyid dang / blon po phying sngon gnyis mig mangs rtse bar chas nas ras gzhi'i steng du rde'u re re tsam rgyag gin yod par/ khrung khrung gsum gyis gral bsgrigs nas lding skor brgyab pa'i grib ma nag yer gyis byung ba dang mnyam du bya brun gcig btang ba ras gzhi de'i steng du rlangs pa phyur re byung / zhes ge sar rgyal po dang blon po phying 144

sngon gnyis kyis bdud yul nas nyin rer sho mig mangs sku rtsed kyi gnas tshul dang / mig gzhong ras gzhi'i steng du rde'u re re tsam 'jog gin 'dug pa'i snang brnyan dag gsal bor zhib 'bri gnang 'dug da dung bod ljongs chab mdo dang khams sde dge gnyis kyi sa mtshams kyi rdo pha bong zhig gi steng du 'gyig gzhong brkos yod la/ yul shul khul chu dmar leb rdzong dang rma lho'i dgu rong khog bcas su yang ge sar rgyal po'i mig mangs rtse shul yin zhes 'gyig rdo'am rdo'i mig gzhong mthong du yod par ma zad/ngag rgyun yang nyan na 'dod cing yid dbang 'gug pa mang bo mchis/ 'di nas nged rnams kyis bod gangs can gyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal lo rgyus ring zhing dar khyab che ba gsal bor shes thub/de ring yang mdo dbus khams gsum gyi mtha' yas rtswa thang yangs pa'i phyugs rdzi rgan po dang / khod snyoms sngo ljang ldan pa'i zhing khar zhing ba rgan po tsho rang rang yul nas lhan du tshogs te/rde'u dkar nag gis mig mangs sam 'gyig ded nas rgyal pham 'gran pa dang spro rtsed la rol ba 'di mthong ba tsam gyis yid la spro 145

ba 'bum gyi dpal sbyin pa'i tshor ba rang dbang med par shar ba ltar ro//bod rigs mig mangs sgyu rtsal gyi 'byung khungs kyi cha nas bshad na/ da lta mkhas pa mang bo'i bzhed pa gcig mthun zhig gtan nas yong bzhin med/ de yang kha cig gis bod kyi mig mangs 'di thog mar rgya nang nas dar zhing rim gyis bod yul du khyab pa yin zhes lung dang rigs pas bsgrubs/ kha cig gis 'byung khungs bod yul yin la/ bon po'i chos lugs kyi rtsis dang mo 'debs pa bcas las byung zhes dpyad gtam brjod bzhin 'dug yang kha cig gis bod yul dang rgya yul gnyis nas mnyam du dar zhing spel ba yin zhes smras so//bod ljongs gna' rdzas sngog 'don pas gna' yi bang so nang nas mig mangs kyi rde'u dkar nag rnyed pa ltar na/ mig mangs 'di rdo chas gsar ba'i skabs su dar ba yin pa kho thag bcad/mnga' ris gu ge rgyal po'i rgyal sa nas kyang da lta'i mig mangs kyi re'u mig dang mthun pa'i ri mo yod pa'i sa rdo rnyed byung /tun hong 146

gter yig las bkod pa ltar na/ btsan po srong btsan sgam po'i yab gnam ri srong btsan gyi blon chen/ khyung po spung sad zu tse rtse zhes pa zhig yod pa chab srid dang dmag don la mkhas par ma zad/ mig mangs rtse bar yang shin tu mkhas zer/ khong gis gzhung don sgrub zhor du mig mangs rtse bar 'gran zla med skad/'dir dpyad na rgyal po srong btsan sgam po'i sngon la mig mangs sgyu rtsal dar rgya che ba sus kyang shes thub bo//dus rabs bcu bdun ba'i skabs su/ bod pa'i mig mangs sgyu rtsal la ched du zhib 'jug byed pa'i dpe deb kyang bskrun yod/dus rabs bcu dgu ba'i skabs su/ bod kyi skad grags che ba'i skar rtsis pa bstan pa rgya mtsho lags kyis bod kyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal gyi gzhung lugs thad du dpe deb gsar ba bris nas spel/des kyang bod kyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal gyi ma lag 'thus tshang gtong bar lag rjes mi dman pa bzhag yod/gang ltar yang lo rgyus kyi yig cha gal chen las bstan pa ltar na/ bod pa'i mig mangs sgyu rtsal ni bod yul rang nas byung zhing 147

dar bar gyur pa sus kyang bsnyon du med/ ma mthar yang srong btsan sgam po'i yab gnam ri srong btsan skabs su mchis pa lo rgyus kyi yig cha las gsal bo shes thub/'gyig gi rnam grangs kyi cha nas bshad na/ blo gsal gyi rtsed chas〈 kun dga' nor bu'i bang mdzod〉las bstan pa ltar na/bod 'gyig gi rnam grangs80lhag yod par gsungs 'dug dper na/ gseg ta'i 'gyig me mda'i 'gyig bzhi 'gyig bya rgod sdong 'gyig a long rgyab thub 'gyig lham 'gyig mi rtag ri mo'i 'gyig rab ldan sgo brgyad 'gyig dpa' bo'i rtse gsum 'gyig rdo rje rgya gram 'gyig bcas 'gyig gi rnam grangs mang bo bgrang rgyu yod de/'di dag da lta mang che shos dmangs khrod du bkol spyod shin tu nyung / tha na ming gi rnam grangs kyang shes mkhan ha cang dkon po 'dug 'di las go thos nyung ba'i 'gyig gi rnam grangs mang bo 'di dag nyams dang nyams bzhin mchis pa gsal bo shes pas nged cag gis 'bad pas myur skyob legs po ma byas na slar gso bya rgyu khag po 'dug148

gangs ri'i yul du dar ba'i bod pa'i mig mangs sgyu rtsal ni/bgrang bya stong phrag du mar sreg bcad brdar gsum brgyud pa'i gser bzhin du yang yang legs bcos mang bo brgyud par brten/da lta ma lag phun sum tshogs pa zhig grub yod/ de'i mig gzhong gi cha nas bltas na/ sna mi gcig pa bcu lhag cig la slebs 'dug pa dang / mig mangs rtse thabs kyi steng nas bltas na mi rgan gyi 'gran bsdur dang byis pa'i spro rtsed bcas sna mang 'dus 'dug mig mangs kyi khyab rgya'i thad du bltas na/ bod pa'i mig mangs 'di rgya rigs dang he rigs/ za lar rigs/ hor rigs/ sog rigs bcas mang bo'i yul du khyab yod la/ mi rigs mi gcig pa de dag kyang spro ba shin tu rgyas pa'i dmangs khrod spro rtsed kyi bya 'gul med du mi rung ba zhig tu gyur yod/ 'di'i steng nas bltas na bod pa'i mig mangs sgyu rtsal ni nyams pa med pa'i tshe srog yod pa gsal ler mtshon thub/ yin na'ang blo pham pa zhig ni da lta mig mangs rtse mkhan gyi mi je nyung dang khyab rgya yang je chung du 'gro bzhin yod pa sus kyang shes gsal ltar ro//149

spyi lo2005lo'i zla drug pa'i nang du yun nan zhing chen bde chen bod rigs rang skyong khul du bod kyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal dus chen bsdus te/ rgyal spyi dang rgyal nang gi mig mangs sgyu rtsal la mkhas pa dang spro ba yod pa'i mgo khrid skor zhig gdan 'dren zhus nas dus chen la zhugs/ bod rang skyong ljongs kyi〈bod ljongs sgyu rtsal zhib 'jug〉gi gtso sgrig pa'am bod kyi mig mangs la zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi ched mkhas pa zla ba bzang po lags gdan 'dren zhus pa ltar bde chen khul la phebs te/ bod kyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal skor la mkhas pa rnams dang lhan du gleng mol bgyis te/khong gis gsung bshad legs po gnang bar tshogs zhugs kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis gdeng 'jog tshad mthon po gnang /skabs 'di yi mig mangs dus chen brgyud nas rgya che ba'i mi dmangs mang tshogs dang rgyal spyi rgyal nang gi mkhas pa rnams la bod pa'i mig mangs sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos dang rin thang khyab bsgrags byas shing / mig mangs sgyu rtsal 'di spyi tshogs ring lugs kyi bsam pa'i dpal yon 'dzugs skrun bya ba'i khrod du 'phel rgyas 150

su gtong dgos pa'i skul ma btang /spyi lo2006lo'i zla brgyad par/ mtsho sngon zhing chen mi dmangs srid gzhung gi hrin krang gzhon pa stag 'bum thar gyis thugs 'khur gnang ba dang / mtsho sngon zhing chen rtsom rig sgyu rtsal mnyam 'brel lhan tshogs kyis mthong chen gnang bar brten/ nged cag mtsho sngon zhing chen ge sar zhib 'jug khang gi zhib 'jug mi sna rnams kyis brtson 'grus la brten nas bod khul gyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal sngog 'don dang myur skyob/srung skyong bya ba legs 'dzin bgyis pa bcas thad du grub 'bras kyang mngon gsal blangs byung / de yang gna' mkhar zi ling nas mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi bod rigs dmangs khrod mig mangs sgyu rtsal 'gran sdur thengs dang po gzab rgyas ngang 'tshogs pa 'di ni/ lo 'khor stong phrag du mar brgyud yong ba'i srol rgyun te dngos po ma yin pa'i rig gnas shul bzhag 'di dag dus rabs nyer gcig par yang bskyar gsar du sos pa'i skal ba ldan par bcug cing / de yang srol rgyun legs po 'di rgyun chad med par rgyun 'dzin dang khyab sgrog rgya cher spel bar 151

btang ste/ bod rigs mi dmangs mang tshogs kyi nyin rer 'phel rgyas su 'gro bzhin pa'i rig gnas 'tsho ba'i dgos mkho phun sum je tshogs su btang nas/ mi dmangs mang tshogs khrod du ja dang 'o ma bzhin 'dres 'dug pa'i dmangs khrod rig gnas kyi churtsoskyes chun po 'di dus nam yang bzhad thub pa'i phyogs su 'bad 'bungs bgyi ba'i gom pa dang po spo thub par gyur/ gsham du lo rgyus ring ba'i bod pa'i mig mangs sgyu rtsal myur skyob dang 'dzin skyong byed pa'i thad la lta tshul 'ga' brjod na 'di lta ste/gcig gangs can bod rig par zhib 'jug gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams kyis rang re'i bod kyi srol rgyun gyi dngos po ma yin pa'i rig gnas shul bzhag dag kyang zhib 'jug gi rnam grangs su bzhag ste/ ma dngul gyi gtong phod ldan par btang ste nan bcag gis 'tshol sdud dang zhib 'jugabargyud nas myur skyob dang 'dzin skyong bya rgyu shin tu gal 'gangs che/ da lta nged cag gi mig lam du nyams la nye ba'i srol rgyun gyi shul bzhag rig gnas 'di dag myur skyob dang srung skyong legs po ma gnang na rgyal khab 152

dang mi rigs rang la gyong gud chen po reg nges/ de bas 'brel yod kyi mkhas pa bgres gzhon tshos bod yig dang rgya yig dbyin yig bcas kyi spel lam spyad de mtshams sbyor gyi rtsom yig dang zhib 'jug dpyad rtsom/ zhib 'jug dpe deb bcas dpar te rgya cher spel nas nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong du spel ba bcas kyi las don la 'bad dgos pa lags/gnyis/ bod rigs sa khul gyi 'brel yod srid gzhung dang 'brel yod mgo khrid rnams kyis ma bskul dang len gyis krung hwa mi rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas te dngos po ma yin pa'i rig gnas shul bzhag gam gzugs med rig gnas thams cad 'dzin skyong spel gsum slad du lo re'i zhing ljongs srid gzhung gi rig gnas ljongs rgyu dus chen skabs su bod kyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal yang dus chen gyi 'gran sdur rnam grangs su bzhag ste gcigs chen gnang dgos pa dang de bzhin khul so so dang rdzong so so/ zhang so so/grong sde so sos kyang mig mangs 'gran rtsed kyi las 'gul spel nas myur skyob dang 'dzin skyong brgyud de mig mangs kyi mig gzhong mi 153

'dra ba dang mig mangs kyi rtse thabs mi 'dra ba thams cad phan tshun slob sbyong dang phan tshun nyams myong brje res bcas byas te mig mangs sgyu rtsal rgya cher spel dgos/gsum/ nges par du bod kyi mig mangs sgyu rtsal myur skyob dang 'dzin skyong ma byas na mi chog pa'i dril bsgrages bya ba dam 'dzin byed dgos/ mi rigs srol rgyun gyi dngos po ma yin pa'i shul bzhag rig gnas dag myur skyob bya rgyu'i thad tang dang rgyal khab kyis yig cha gal chen gang mang btang yod/ nged cag gis 'thob par dka' ba'i go skabs 'di dam 'dzin ma byas na phyis su blo 'gyod zad thabs med pa zhig skyes yong / de bas nged cag bod pa rnams kyis ngos zin mthor 'degs btang nas gang sa gang du ngag thog dang yig thog tu mig mangs myur skyob kyi gal chen rang bzhin dril bsgrags bya rgyu shin tu gal che/ khyad par du brnyan 'phrin dang rlung 'phrin/ tshags par dus deb bcas brgyud nas dril bsgrags yang yang gnang rgyu ni de bas kyang gal 'gangs che/rgyu mtshan yang gcig ni srid gzhung gi tshab thub pa dang / gnyis ni 154

dril bsgrags kyi khyab che bas so//gzhan yang 'brel yod las khungs dang sde khag gis gzhi rim gyi mig mangs la mkhas pa'i zhing ba rgan pa dang 'brog pa rgan pa dag gdan drangs te brnyan 'phrin dang rlung 'phrin bcas su mig mangs kyi lo rgyus dag brgyud sgrog byed par 'jug pa dang / slob grwa chen mo dang slob 'bring bcas su yang dge slob rnams la mig mangs kyi rgyun shes thad kyi slob khrid byed du bcug na ci ma rung /spyir na nyams la nye ba'i srol rgyun gyi gzugs med rig gnas shul bzhag cig myur skyob gnang ste sngon ma dang mtshungs pa'i 'phel rgyas shig yong rgyu ni ha cang las sla mo zhig min pa sus kyang mkhyen gsal ltar ro/ /bya dngos gang yang dar ba dka' yang nyams pa sla ba ni chos nyid cig go /yin yang nged cag thams cad kyis blo sems gcig sgril gyis 'bad 'bungs lhod med dang /snying rus cher bskyed na rang re'i 'od zer ldan pa'i bod pa'i mig mangs sgyu rtsal 'di nyams pa sor chud thub cing yun nas yun du dar rgyas yong bar yid ches brtan po mchis so/155

mchan/du'agyig 'gyig dang mig mangs kyi dbye ba ste/ a mdo dmangs khrod du 'gyig 'di dang mig mangs 'di yin zhes dbye ba med la/ 'gyig gam mig mangs yod tshad la 'gyig ces 'bod pa ma gtogs mig mangs zhes 'bod srol chags med/ yin na'ang yig thog tu mig mangs zhes 'bri srol yod/ 4kho bo'i bsam par/ a mdo dmangs khrod du mig mangs zhes 'bod srol chags med na yang / 'gyig dang mig mangs gnyis bar du dbye ba gsal bo mchis/ de yang 'gyig ces pa nya 'gyig dang / rgyal po dang blon po'i 'gyig spyang ki dang lug gi 'gyigabacir 'gyig bcas la zer ba dang / mig mangs zhes pa drug 'gyig dang bdun 'gyig dgu 'gyig ces pa re'u mig gru bzhi can la zer ba yin/ gsham du 'gyig dang mig mangs kyi dbye ba ji ltar yin pa 'gyig gzhong gi rigs las gsal bo shes thub/ 156
— rdordordo sdo

mtsho sngon mtsho lho'i dmangs srol rol rtsed las bod kyi btsir 'gyig ngo sprod mdor bsdus/mang ra'i lo yagaspyir 'gyig ni mi rnams kyis gna' snga mo'i thon skyed 'tsho ba'i khrod du bsam mno'i nus rtsal la brten nas gsar skrun byas pa yin la/ lhag par du dus yun ring ba'i dmag 'khrug gi rgyal pham sogs brgyud nas 'thus tshang du gyur pa zhig yin pas 'gyig la rnam grangs ha cang mang / de bzhin bod 'gyig la mtshon na'ang rgyal 'gyig dang / bcir 'gyig dgu 'gyig bdun 'gyig drug 'gyig 'gyig bo'u rgyag 'gyig ta len/ 'bangs gyen log gi 'gyig sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i mi rigs kyi khyad chos ldan pa'i 'gyig sna phun sum tshogs pa zhig yod la/ de dag las bdag gis 'dir 161

brjod pa ni btsir 'gyig ngo sprod bya rgyu de yin/mtsho lho'i dmangs srol rol rtsed las bcir 'gyig gi khyab khongs ni mtsho lho khul gyi kos nan rdzong dang / thun te rdzong / khri ka rdzong / gung ho rdzong gi rong 'brog sa khul yin/ gtso bo ni kos nan rdzong gi mang ra zhang dang / gung ho rdzong gi mtsho sngon po sogs yin mod/ da lta thun te rdzong dang / gung ho rdzong / kos nan rdzong gi thar shul zhang / mgo mang zhang sogs na lnga 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig 'ded pa las dgu 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig 'ded srol phal cher nyams 'dug dgu 'gyig gi 'ded srol tsam ma nyams pa'i khyab khongs gtso bo ni kos nan rdzong gi mang ra zhang yin/ yul de ni dmangs khrod kyi rig gnas dag ma nyams par gnas pa'i yul gru zhig yin/ dper na mda' rtsed dang / 'gyig rigs/byis pa'i rtsed mo/ bod rigs dmangs khrod kyi gna' rabs rol chas kyi dbyangs rta sogs kyang ma nyams par gnas yod pa dus rgyun du mthong thub/gcig btsir 'gyig gi dbye ba bshad pa/162

bcir 'gyig la dgu 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig dang / bdun 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig lnga 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig gsum du dbye/deng skabs dmangs khrod du khyab rgya che ba ni lnga 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig yin zhing drug 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig dang / bdun 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig ni ches nyung shas yin/ rgyu mtshan ni de gsum gyi 'ded stangs 'dra'ang dgu 'gyig dang / bdun 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig la mtshon na 'gyig rde'u 'jog sa'i gnas mang ba dang /ded na 'ded yun ring bas dus yun thung thung gi nang du 'gyig pa phan tshun bar la rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed dka'/ de ltar dus tshod sogs 'gor 'gyangs bzos na rang gis sgrub dgos pa'i bya ba la bar chad 'byung bar dogs nas dgu 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig ni sa cha mang che ba nas 'ded rgyun nyams rgud du 'gyur bzhin yod/ yin na'ang da dung sa cha re gnyis na dgu 'gyig dang /bdun 'gyig 'ded pa'i rgyun tsam 'dugalnga 'gyig gi bcir 'gyig ni de las ldog ste 'gyig de'u 'jog sa'i gnas nyung zhing /'ded pa'i dus yun thung la/ rgyal pham gyi dbye ba 'byed sla bas 163
